sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 在 2011 年，人们在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园里发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血液也被抽干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 看起来凶手费尽心机来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 在十多年的时间里，她只被称为无名女尸。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 随后，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是 Casefile Presents 的全新系列，各大播客平台现已上线。

sentences.en: Today's episode involves crimes against children, and won't be suitable for all listeners.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目涉及针对儿童的犯罪，并非适合所有听众。

sentences.en: Friday, April 13, 1973 was an exhausting day for the Kennedy family.
sentences.zh: 1973 年 4 月 13 日，星期五，对肯尼迪一家来说是筋疲力尽的一天。

sentences.en: 24-year-old Faye and her two young daughters, 5-year-old Stephanie and 17-month-old Deidre,
sentences.zh: 24 岁的费伊和她两个年幼的女儿，5 岁的斯蒂芬妮和 17 个月大的迪德丽，

sentences.en: had just returned home to the small Queensland city of Ipswich after a six-week trip visiting relatives further up north.
sentences.zh: 在去更北方的亲戚家进行了为期六周的旅行后，刚刚返回昆士兰州小城伊普斯维奇的家中。

sentences.en: It had required a 17-hour bus ride home, and none of them had gotten much sleep.
sentences.zh: 这需要坐 17 个小时的巴士回家，她们谁也没怎么睡好。

sentences.en: Faye's husband, Barry, was recovering from knee surgery, and the effort of hobbling around on crutches left him drained of energy.
sentences.zh: 费伊的丈夫巴里正在从膝盖手术中恢复，拄着拐杖蹒跚前行的劳累让他精疲力竭。

sentences.en: They took it slow that day.
sentences.zh: 那天他们过得很悠闲。

sentences.en: Stephanie and Deidre were often excitable around bedtime, but as night approached, they got ready for bed
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬妮和迪德丽在临睡前往往很兴奋，但随着夜幕降临，她们准备上床睡觉时

sentences.en: without proteSt. Faye prepared Deidre's favourite meal, tomato soup with a side of asparagus spears.
sentences.zh: 并没有抗拒。费伊为迪德丽准备了她最喜欢的饭菜：番茄汤配芦笋尖。

sentences.en: After giving the girls a bath, Faye put Deidre into a fresh nappy with a waterproof cover on top known as a pilcher.
sentences.zh: 给女孩们洗过澡后，费伊给迪德丽换上了一件崭新的尿布，外面套着防水罩，这种防水罩被称为 pilcher。

sentences.en: She then dressed her in a singlet and a new pair of pink pyjamas adorned with bunny motifs.
sentences.zh: 然后她给她穿上一件背心和一套饰有小兔子图案的新粉色睡衣。

sentences.en: Deidre was excited about her new pyjamas and showed them off proudly to her father.
sentences.zh: 迪德丽对她的新睡衣兴奋不已，并自豪地向父亲展示。

sentences.en: The Kennedys lived in a two-bedroom, single-storey unit.
sentences.zh: 肯尼迪一家住在两居室的单层公寓里。

sentences.en: Stephanie and Deidre shared a small bedroom at the end of the hallway adjacent to their parents.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬妮和迪德丽共用走廊尽头紧邻父母卧室的一间小卧室。

sentences.en: The two girls were incredibly close.
sentences.zh: 这两个女孩感情好得不可思议。

sentences.en: Stephanie doted on her baby sister, whom she affectionately called Dee Dee.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬妮对她的妹妹疼爱有加，亲切地称她为迪迪。

sentences.en: At 7.30pm,
sentences.zh: 晚上 7 点 30 分，

sentences.en: Faye placed a sleepy Deidre in her cot near the bedroom door.
sentences.zh: 费伊把昏昏欲睡的迪德丽放进靠近卧室门的婴儿床里。

sentences.en: An hour later, she tucked Stephanie into her bed below the open window.
sentences.zh: 一个小时后，她把斯蒂芬妮塞进开着窗户的床铺下。

sentences.en: Faye and Barry spent some time together before retiring to bed at around 10 o'clock.
sentences.zh: 费伊和巴里在一起待了一会儿，然后在大约 10 点钟上床睡觉。

sentences.en: Faye checked in on her daughters one last time.
sentences.zh: 费伊最后一次查看了女儿们的情况。

sentences.en: Both girls were sleeping soundly.
sentences.zh: 两个女孩都睡得很香。

sentences.en: Faye pulled the aluminium sliding window and curtains shut before tenderly tucking the girls in and leaving the room.
sentences.zh: 费伊拉上铝合金推拉窗和窗帘，然后温柔地给女孩们掖好被子，走出房间。

sentences.en: She fell asleep easily, worn out from the long day.
sentences.zh: 她很快就睡着了，长途跋涉让她精疲力竭。

sentences.en: The following morning,
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，

sentences.en: Faye was awoken suddenly by Stephanie shaking her shoulder.
sentences.zh: 费伊被斯蒂芬妮摇晃肩膀突然唤醒。

sentences.en: The five-year-old looked concerned.
sentences.zh: 这个五岁的小女孩看起来很担忧。

sentences.en: Wake up, she said.
sentences.zh: 醒醒，她说。

sentences.en: Dee Dee's not in her bed.
sentences.zh: 迪迪不在她的床上。

sentences.en: Faye Kennedy loved nothing more than being a mother.
sentences.zh: 费伊·肯尼迪最喜欢做的事情就是当母亲。

sentences.en: She cared for her two daughters full-time, while Barry supported the family by working as an instrument fitter for the Royal Australian Air Force.
sentences.zh: 她全职照顾两个女儿，而巴里则在澳大利亚皇家空军担任仪表装配工来养家糊口。

sentences.en: It was this role that had recently landed the Kennedys in Ipswich, located 40 kilometres west of Brisbane.
sentences.zh: 正是这份工作最近让肯尼迪一家来到了位于布里斯班以西 40 公里处的伊普斯维奇。

sentences.en: Barry was transferred there in late 1972 and the family settled into the two-bedroom unit on Short Street.
sentences.zh: 巴里于 1972 年底被调到那里，一家人定居在短街的两居室公寓里。

sentences.en: Theirs was one of four units in a small cream-brick block owned by the Air Force.
sentences.zh: 这是空军拥有的一个小型乳白色砖混建筑群中的四套公寓之一。

sentences.en: The move was just temporary while they awaited assignment of a bigger house.
sentences.zh: 这次搬迁只是临时的，他们在等待分配更大的房子。

sentences.en: But the unit's location on the edge of town, just 350 metres from Limestone Park
sentences.zh: 但该公寓位于镇边缘，距离石灰石公园仅 350 米，

sentences.en: and a 15-minute drive from the Air Force base in the nearby suburb of Amberley, suited them fine for now.
sentences.zh: 距离附近安伯利郊区的空军基地有 15 分钟车程，目前对他们来说非常合适。

sentences.en: The slow pace of Ipswich matched the Kennedys' small-town mentality.
sentences.zh: 伊普斯维奇的慢节奏与肯尼迪夫妇的小镇心态不谋而合。

sentences.en: Having been raised in the outback,
sentences.zh: 由于在内陆长大，

sentences.en: Barry and Faye were country kids at heart.
sentences.zh: 巴里和费伊骨子里都是乡下孩子。

sentences.en: Quiet and trusting, they had lived a relatively sheltered lives and believed in the best of people.
sentences.zh: 他们性格安静、容易信任他人，过着相对单纯的生活，并且相信人性本善。

sentences.en: When the couple awoke to find baby Deirdre wasn't in her cot, they desperately searched their house.
sentences.zh: 当这对夫妇醒来发现婴儿迪德丽不在婴儿床里时，他们在屋里绝望地搜寻起来。

sentences.en: The 17-month-old had only recently started walking, having scooted around on her bottom until she'd managed to find her feet.
sentences.zh: 这个 17 个月大的孩子最近才开始学走路，之前一直是用屁股蹭着挪动，直到她设法站稳脚跟。

sentences.en: She was still shaky on her legs, and there was no way she could have climbed out of her cot or opened any doors on her own.
sentences.zh: 她的双腿依然颤颤巍巍，根本不可能自己爬出婴儿床或打开任何门。

sentences.en: Regardless, the Kennedys looked through the small unit, checking under beds and furniture as they called Deirdre's name.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，肯尼迪夫妇还是搜查了这套小公寓，一边叫着迪德丽的名字，一边检查床铺和家具下方。

sentences.en: They searched outside before knocking on their neighbour's door.
sentences.zh: 他们在外面搜寻，然后敲响了邻居的门。

sentences.en: He hadn't seen Deirdre or heard anything out of the ordinary.
sentences.zh: 他没有看到迪德丽，也没有听到任何异常的声音。

sentences.en: The green open spaces offered by Limestone Park made it a popular recreation spot for residents of Ipswich.
sentences.zh: 石灰石公园提供的绿色开阔空间使其成为伊普斯维奇居民的热门休闲场所。

sentences.en: Located just a few minutes' drive from the town centre, the sprawling park was framed by a blend of residential streets and main thoroughfares.
sentences.zh: 这座错落有致的公园距离镇中心仅几分钟车程，四周环绕着住宅区街道和主干道。

sentences.en: Adults and children alike frequented the area to exercise, play sports, and walk their pets among the mostly flat land dotted with a scattering of native trees.
sentences.zh: 成年人和儿童经常光顾此地进行锻炼、开展体育运动以及遛宠物，这里的土地大体平坦，点缀着零星的本土树木。

sentences.en: Horse trainer Westy Mills was one such resident.
sentences.zh: 驯马师韦斯蒂·米尔斯就是这样一位居民。

sentences.en: The sun had barely risen on the morning of Saturday April 14, 1973, as Westy trotted one of his horses across the dewy oval.
sentences.zh: 1973 年 4 月 14 日星期六早晨，太阳刚刚升起，韦斯蒂牵着他的一匹马穿过长满露水的椭圆形草坪。

sentences.en: There were few other people around save for a jogger and a duo with a dog.
sentences.zh: 周围几乎没有什么其他人，除了一个慢跑者和一对带着狗的人。

sentences.en: As Westy passed a public toilet block on the western edge of the park, he noticed something hanging off the edge of the flat tin roof.
sentences.zh: 当韦斯蒂经过公园西边缘的一个公共厕所时，他注意到有什么东西挂在平坦的铁皮屋顶边缘。

sentences.en: He pulled his horse to a stop so he could get a closer look.
sentences.zh: 他勒住马停下来，以便能仔细看看。

sentences.en: At first,
sentences.zh: 起初，

sentences.en: Westy thought it was a rag doll.
sentences.zh: 韦斯蒂以为那是一个布娃娃。

sentences.en: He then realised what exactly he was looking at.
sentences.zh: 然后他意识到自己究竟看到了什么。

sentences.en: Westy cried out in shock.
sentences.zh: 韦斯蒂惊恐地尖叫起来。

sentences.en: Help, there's a baby here.
sentences.zh: 救命，这里有个婴儿。

sentences.en: Westy Mills desperately climbed onto the toilet block roof and retrieved the baby's body.
sentences.zh: 韦斯蒂·米尔斯绝望地爬上厕所屋顶，找回了婴儿的尸体。

sentences.en: It was a young girl who had died a violent death.
sentences.zh: 这是一个遭遇暴力死亡的小女孩。

sentences.en: She was wearing a pink pajama top, but her pajama bottoms and nappy had been removed and tossed aside.
sentences.zh: 她穿着粉红色的睡衣上衣，但睡衣裤子和尿布已经被脱掉并扔在一旁。

sentences.en: In their place was women's underwear, a pair of blue panties, elastic step-ins with suspenders, and a silk half-slip skirt.
sentences.zh: 取而代之的是女式内衣、一条蓝色内裤、带吊袜带的弹性连裤袜以及一条丝绸半身衬裙。

sentences.en: The local police were summoned along with detectives from Brisbane.
sentences.zh: 当地警察被召集前来，布里斯班的侦探也随即赶到。

sentences.en: The site made even the most seasoned investigator's recoil.
sentences.zh: 这个现场让见多识广的调查人员也感到胃部翻滚。

sentences.en: The baby's face and neck were covered in bruises and there was bruising to her lower thigh.
sentences.zh: 婴儿的脸和脖子上布满淤青，她的大腿根部也有淤青。

sentences.en: There was a small abrasion near one of her eyes and on her upper lip.
sentences.zh: 她的一只眼睛附近和上唇有一处小擦伤。

sentences.en: She had been sexually assaulted and strangled.
sentences.zh: 她遭到性侵并被勒死。

sentences.en: Around this time, a neighbour of the Kennedy family ran to the police station as neither of them had a phone.
sentences.zh: 大约在这个时候，肯尼迪一家的一个邻居跑向警察局，因为他们家里都没有电话。

sentences.en: As soon as the officer on duty heard that a baby was missing from Short Street, he had no doubt.
sentences.zh: 值班警员一听说短街有个婴儿失踪，便毫不怀疑。

sentences.en: The baby in Limestone Park was Deirdre Kennedy.
sentences.zh: 石灰石公园里的婴儿就是迪德丽·肯尼迪。

sentences.en: Ipswich's chief of police remarked,
sentences.zh: 伊普斯维奇警察局长评论说：

sentences.en: This, by its circumstances, is the most brutal murder I have ever seen.
sentences.zh: 从各方面情况来看，这是我见过最残忍的谋杀案。

sentences.en: Barry Kennedy was summoned to identify his daughter.
sentences.zh: 巴里·肯尼迪被传唤去辨认他的女儿。

sentences.en: He couldn't bring himself to tell
sentences.zh: 他狠不下心告诉

sentences.en: Faye exactly what had happened, just that Deirdre had been killed.
sentences.zh: 费伊究竟发生了什么，只说迪德丽已经遇害了。

sentences.en: The devoted parents were beside themselves.
sentences.zh: 这对悲痛欲绝的父母心如刀割。

sentences.en: They tried to hold it together for Stephanie's sake, but they were consumed by guilt as they blamed themselves for what had happened.
sentences.zh: 为了斯蒂芬妮，他们强打精神，但由于自责发生的一切，他们被内疚感吞噬。

sentences.en: Although Faye had checked the unit and closed the girl's window before she went to bed the night before, she hadn't locked the door.
sentences.zh: 尽管费伊前一天晚上睡觉前检查了公寓并关上了女孩们的窗户，但她没有锁门。

sentences.en: This wasn't unusual.
sentences.zh: 这并不罕见。

sentences.en: Ipswich was considered a safe city and it was customary for residents to leave their doors unlocked.
sentences.zh: 伊普斯维奇被认为是一个安全的城市，居民出门不锁门习以为常。

sentences.en: It wasn't in Faye or Barry's upbringing to be overly vigilant about securing their home.
sentences.zh: 费伊和巴里的成长背景让他们对确保家里的安全并没有过度警惕。

sentences.en: Police visited Short Street to look for evidence.
sentences.zh: 警察来到短街寻找证据。

sentences.en: Although Faye was certain she'd clicked the sliding window closed, it was now slightly ajar.
sentences.zh: 尽管费伊确信自己已经把推拉窗关得严丝合缝，但现在它却微微敞开着。

sentences.en: Police dusted the property for unknown fingerprints.
sentences.zh: 警察在屋里提取未知指纹。

sentences.en: They'd already uncovered some on the door of the toilet block at Limestone Park.
sentences.zh: 他们已经在石灰石公园的厕所门上发现了一些。

sentences.en: No foreign prints were detected on the Kennedy's window, but there was one on the front door.
sentences.zh: 肯尼迪家的窗户上没有检测到外来指纹，但在前门上发现了一个。

sentences.en: It couldn't be determined whether the killer had accessed the house via the door or the window.
sentences.zh: 目前无法确定凶手是通过大门还是窗户进入屋内的。

sentences.en: If they'd used the door, they would have had to skulk quietly down the short hallway at the risk of waking the parents.
sentences.zh: 如果他们使用的是大门，就必须悄悄穿过短短的走廊，冒着惊醒父母的风险。

sentences.en: Had they used the window, they would have had to climb over Stephanie's bed.
sentences.zh: 如果他们使用的是窗户，就必须翻过斯蒂芬妮的床。

sentences.en: But the five-year-old hadn't stirred at any point, nor did she recall hearing or seeing anyone enter the room.
sentences.zh: 但这个五岁的小女孩自始至终都没有惊醒，也不记得听到或看到任何人进入房间。

sentences.en: Deidre was painfully shy and her parents had no doubt that she would have cried if woken by a stranger.
sentences.zh: 迪德丽极其害羞，她的父母深信如果被陌生人吵醒她一定会哭泣。

sentences.en: But no one in the Kennedy household had heard Deidre crying.
sentences.zh: 但肯尼迪家没有一个人听到迪德丽的哭声。

sentences.en: Although they couldn't rule out the possibility entirely, investigators didn't think that Deidre had been strangled at the same time she was abducted.
sentences.zh: 尽管不能完全排除这种可能性，但调查人员认为迪德丽并不是在被绑架的同时遭到勒死的。

sentences.en: Either the killer had managed to scoop Deidre up without waking her, or the rest of the family had been so exhausted from their long day that they'd slept through her tears.
sentences.zh: 要么是凶手设法在不吵醒迪德丽的情况下将她抱走，要么是家里其他人因为长途跋涉太累而对她的哭声熟睡不觉。

sentences.en: Seventy-three-year-old
sentences.zh: 73 岁的

sentences.en: Cecil Carroll lived next door to the Kennedy's in a large, single-storey house.
sentences.zh: 塞西尔·卡罗尔住在肯尼迪家隔壁的一栋大型单层住宅里。

sentences.en: The two properties were separated only by some overgrown shrubs.
sentences.zh: 这两处房产仅被一些杂草丛生的灌木丛隔开。

sentences.en: Cecil boarded there with the eight-member Borscht family and mostly kept to himself in his bedroom at the end of the house.
sentences.zh: 塞西尔寄宿在那里，同住的还有八口之家波什一家，他平时大多独自待在屋子尽头的卧室里。

sentences.en: On the night of Friday April 13,
sentences.zh: 在 4 月 13 日星期五的晚上，

sentences.en: Cecil hadn't been feeling well and was resting in bed.
sentences.zh: 塞西尔感觉身体有些不舒服，正在床上休息。

sentences.en: As he lit up a cigarette at around 10pm, he noticed something moving outside of his bedroom window.
sentences.zh: 晚上 10 点左右，当他点燃一支香烟时，他注意到卧室窗外有什么东西在动。

sentences.en: The window opened out to the home's wraparound veranda which housed a makeshift washing line.
sentences.zh: 窗户朝着房子的环绕式走廊开着，走廊上有一个简易晾衣绳。

sentences.en: At first, Cecil thought it was one of the
sentences.zh: 起初，塞西尔以为那是

sentences.en: Borscht kids.
sentences.zh: 波什家的孩子之一。

sentences.en: But as he watched on, he realised it was a male who looked to be aged between 18 and 20 years old.
sentences.zh: 但当他继续观察时，他意识到那是一个看起来在 18 到 20 岁之间的男性。

sentences.en: He was about 172cm tall, with a slender build of around 63kg.
sentences.zh: 他身高约 172 厘米，身材苗条，体重约 63 公斤。

sentences.en: His hair was collar-length and light brown to blonde in colour.
sentences.zh: 他的头发长及衣领，呈浅棕色至金色。

sentences.en: After watching for a few minutes, Cecil realised the prowler was taking items from the washing line.
sentences.zh: 观察了几分钟后，塞西尔意识到这个不速之客正在从晾衣绳上拿东西。

sentences.en: He got out of bed and alerted the patriarch of the household,
sentences.zh: 他起床并惊动了这户人家的大家长，

sentences.en: Arthur Borscht.
sentences.zh: 亚瑟·波什。

sentences.en: Arthur went outside and checked the veranda.
sentences.zh: 亚瑟走到外面检查了走廊。

sentences.en: There was no one there.
sentences.zh: 那里一个人也没有。

sentences.en: He told Cecil to go back to bed.
sentences.zh: 他叫塞西尔回床上睡觉。

sentences.en: Shortly after, Arthur looked out the window and noticed the male figure walking towards the Air Force units next door.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，亚瑟向窗外望去，注意到那个男性身影正朝着隔壁的空军公寓走去。

sentences.en: It was difficult to see anything through the darkness, but the figure appeared to be in his late teens and around 170cm tall.
sentences.zh: 黑暗中很难看清任何东西，但这个身影看起来像是十几岁后期，身高约 170 厘米。

sentences.en: It was only upon closer inspection the following day that the Borscht's realised several items were missing from their washing line.
sentences.zh: 直到第二天仔细检查时，波什一家才发现他们的晾衣绳上丢了好几件东西。

sentences.en: A pair of blue panties, elastic step-ins and a silk half-slip skirt.
sentences.zh: 一条蓝色内裤、弹性连裤袜以及一条丝绸半身衬裙。

sentences.en: The undergarments that Deidre Kennedy had been dressed in.
sentences.zh: 正是迪德丽·肯尼迪被穿上的内衣。

sentences.en: Police showed Cecil Carroll a photographic line-up of potential suspects, but he ruled each of them out as the prowler.
sentences.zh: 警察向塞西尔·卡罗尔展示了潜在嫌疑人的照片阵容，但他排除了其中每一个人作为潜入者。

sentences.en: Another resident of the household,
sentences.zh: 该家庭的另一位成员，

sentences.en: 12-year-old Paul Borscht, had been at a barbecue with friends earlier that evening.
sentences.zh: 12 岁的保罗·波什，当天早些时候曾和朋友们一起参加烧烤活动。

sentences.en: He told police that when he returned home, he saw a young man walking in the direction of Limestone Park.
sentences.zh: 他告诉警察，当他回到家时，他看到一个年轻男子正朝石灰石公园方向走去。

sentences.en: He was carrying something white over his shoulder.
sentences.zh: 他肩膀上扛着白色的东西。

sentences.en: Police ultimately ruled Paul's sighting out, but they had no doubt that the man Cecil spired outside his window was the same person who killed
sentences.zh: 警察最终排除了保罗目击的情况，但他们毫不怀疑塞西尔在窗外看到的男子就是杀害

sentences.en: Deidre.
sentences.zh: 迪德丽的同一个人。

sentences.en: News of Deidre's death rattled the community.
sentences.zh: 迪德丽死讯的消息震惊了整个社区。

sentences.en: People not only felt deeply for the
sentences.zh: 人们不仅对

sentences.en: Kennedy family, but also feared for the safety of their own children.
sentences.zh: 肯尼迪一家深感同情，同时也为自己孩子的安全感到担忧。

sentences.en: It was in everyone's best interest that the case be solved fast, and the public came forward with any details they thought could help.
sentences.zh: 尽快破案符合所有人的最大利益，公众纷纷提供他们认为有帮助的任何细节。

sentences.en: Investigators considered whether the killer could have assaulted Deidre at another location or inside a vehicle before dumping her body in Limestone Park.
sentences.zh: 调查人员考虑凶手是否可能在其他地点或车内对迪德丽实施袭击，然后才将她的尸体抛在石灰石公园。

sentences.en: Witnesses reported seeing four different vehicles in the area on the night in question, but nothing pointed towards a clear suspect.
sentences.zh: 目击者报告说，事发当晚在附近看到了四辆不同的车辆，但没有任何线索指向明确的嫌疑人。

sentences.en: Police urged the public to report anyone who was acting out of character in the days following the crime.
sentences.zh: 警方敦促公众举报在案发后几天里行为反常的任何人。

sentences.en: They considered the possibility that more than one person could have been involved, but deemed it much more likely that the perpetrator had acted alone.
sentences.zh: 他们考虑了不止一人涉案的可能性，但认为作案者单独行事的可能性要大得多。

sentences.en: Extensive door knocks were carried out in a bid to determine whether any young males were absent from their homes on the night of Friday April 13.
sentences.zh: 警方进行了大规模的逐户排查，旨在确定在 4 月 13 日星期五晚上是否有任何年轻男性不在家中。

sentences.en: Over 3,500 local males voluntarily provided their fingerprints to eliminate themselves from the investigation.
sentences.zh: 超过 3500 名当地男性自愿提供指纹以洗清自己的嫌疑。

sentences.en: Known sex offenders and psychiatric patients were checked and ruled out.
sentences.zh: 已知的性犯罪者和精神病患者经过排查已被排除。

sentences.en: Several leads emerged, but none that led to any breakthroughs.
sentences.zh: 出现了一些线索，但没有一条带来突破。

sentences.en: Police deduced the killer either lived locally or was very familiar with the area.
sentences.zh: 警察推断凶手要么住在当地，要么对该地区非常熟悉。

sentences.en: The toilet block in Limestone Park was mere minutes from the Kennedy's unit, so it was probable that the killer had chosen that destination on purpose rather than one of them.
sentences.zh: 石灰石公园的公厕距离肯尼迪家的公寓只有几分钟路程，因此凶手很可能是故意选择那个目的地，而不是由他们选择。

sentences.en: Given that the Kennedys were relatively new to the area, mostly kept to themselves and had no known enemies, it seemed unlikely that this was a targeted attack.
sentences.zh: 鉴于肯尼迪一家搬到该地区不久，平时深居简出且没有结下仇家，这似乎不太可能是一起有针对性的袭击。

sentences.en: It was more likely the work of an opportunistic predator.
sentences.zh: 这更像是机会主义掠夺者的行径。

sentences.en: Forensic examination of Deirdre's body determined she'd died by strangulation.
sentences.zh: 对代尔德尸体的法医检查确认，她是因机械性窒息而死。

sentences.en: The bruises on her face and neck had been made by a human hand.
sentences.zh: 她面部和颈部的淤青是由人类的手造成的。

sentences.en: No semen or other bodily fluid was detected, but the killer had left behind a single pubic hair and some hair-like fibres.
sentences.zh: 没有检测到精液或其他体液，但凶手留下一根阴毛和一些类似头发的纤维。

sentences.en: Although DNA profiling didn't exist at the time, there was one other clue.
sentences.zh: 尽管当时还没有DNAProfiling（DNA分析技术），但还有另一个线索。

sentences.en: On Deirdre's left thigh, just above the knee, were two small, curved bruises about one and a half centimetres long.
sentences.zh: 在代尔德的左大腿上，膝盖上方一点，有两个小而弯曲的淤青，大约有一点五厘米长。

sentences.en: It was a human bite mark.
sentences.zh: 这是一个人类的咬痕。

sentences.en: The bite hadn't been hard enough to break the skin, but the bruising was visible enough for dental experts to determine that the killer had an unusual set of teeth.
sentences.zh: 咬痕的力度并不足以咬破皮肤，但淤青足够清晰，足以让牙科专家断定凶手有一口不同寻常的牙齿。

sentences.en: Based on the irregular pattern of the bruises, the killer likely had a protruding overbite.
sentences.zh: 根据淤青不规则的形状，凶手很可能有明显的暴牙。

sentences.en: This meant that their top and bottom teeth didn't meet when their jaw was shut and their front teeth stuck out.
sentences.zh: 这意味着他们的上下牙齿在下巴闭合时无法对齐，而且门牙向前突出。

sentences.en: The bruising also indicated that there was a slight deformity to the killer's two front teeth.
sentences.zh: 淤青还表明，凶手的两颗门牙存在轻微的畸形。

sentences.en: It was possible the teeth were chipped or broken.
sentences.zh: 这些牙齿有可能出现缺损或断裂。

sentences.en: At the time of Deirdre's murder, her father Barry's knee injury had left him incapacitated.
sentences.zh: 在代尔德遇害时，她的父亲巴里因为膝盖受伤而丧失了行动能力。

sentences.en: Even moving around the unit was a struggle.
sentences.zh: 甚至在屋子里走动都很吃力。

sentences.en: Regardless, the police had to consider all theories and they couldn't exclude the possibility that Deirdre had been killed by someone closest to her.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，警方必须考虑所有的推论，他们不能排除代尔德是被她最亲近的人杀害的可能性。

sentences.en: After all, it would explain how she was carried outside without raising an alarm.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，这就能解释为什么她能在不惊动任何人的情况下被抱到外面。

sentences.en: Barry
sentences.zh: 巴里

sentences.en: Kennedy's teeth were compared to the bite marks.
sentences.zh: 肯尼迪的牙齿与咬痕进行了比对。

sentences.en: They didn't match.
sentences.zh: 它们并不匹配。

sentences.en: The grieving father was quickly eliminated from the investigation.
sentences.zh: 这位悲痛的父亲很快就被排除了嫌疑。

sentences.en: Barry was close with his cousin, Keith Kennedy, who lived just 40 kilometres away in the Brisbane suburbs.
sentences.zh: 巴里与他的表弟基斯·肯尼迪关系密切，基斯住在仅仅40公里外的布里斯班郊区。

sentences.en: The two had spent time together in Ipswich the day before Faye and the girls returned home from their trip to Longreach visiting relatives.
sentences.zh: 在费伊和女孩们从朗里奇探亲回家的前一天，两人曾在伊普斯威奇聚过。

sentences.en: According to the book Justice in Jeopardy by Debbie Marshall, while Barry didn't think his cousin was capable of hurting Deirdre.
sentences.zh: 根据黛博拉·马歇尔所著的书《处于危险中的正义》，虽然巴里认为他的表弟不可能伤害代尔德。

sentences.en: The police thought otherwise.
sentences.zh: 但警方却不这么认为。

sentences.en: Three years earlier, Keith had been accused of biting a three-year-old girl on the vagina.
sentences.zh: 三年前，基斯曾被指控咬了一个三岁女孩的私处。

sentences.en: He was tried for the indecent assault of a child and found not guilty for reasons of insanity.
sentences.zh: 他因猥亵儿童罪受审，但以精神失常为由被判无罪。

sentences.en: The incident brought great shame to Keith's family, and it was never talked about.
sentences.zh: 这件事给基斯的家族带来了巨大的耻辱，从此再无人提起。

sentences.en: For investigators, Keith Kennedy seemed like a promising suspect.
sentences.zh: 对于调查人员来说，基斯·肯尼迪看起来是一个很有嫌疑的对象。

sentences.en: He knew the family and the Ipswich area and had a past history of offending.
sentences.zh: 他熟悉这个家庭和伊普斯威奇地区，并且有犯罪前科。

sentences.en: Furthermore, Keith was blonde and roughly 177 centimetres tall, not too far off from the young man seen prowling around the Kennedy's unit on the night Deirdre was taken.
sentences.zh: 此外，基斯金发碧眼，身高大约177厘米，这与代尔德被带走当晚在肯尼迪家住房周围徘徊的年轻男子相差无几。

sentences.en: His dentition was also unique in that there was a significant gap between his two front teeth, and they slightly protruded.
sentences.zh: 他的牙齿结构也很独特，两颗门牙之间有明显的缝隙，并且微微向前突出。

sentences.en: Police questioned Keith Kennedy, who claimed he'd been at home with his brother and sister on the night Deirdre was abducted.
sentences.zh: 警方对基斯·肯尼迪进行了讯问，他声称在代尔德被绑架的当晚，他一直和他的兄弟姐妹在家。

sentences.en: Keith's fingerprints and dental records were compared against those found at the crime scene.
sentences.zh: 基斯的指纹和牙科记录被拿来与犯罪现场发现的指纹和牙科记录进行比对。

sentences.en: There was no match.
sentences.zh: 两者并不匹配。

sentences.en: Months continued to pass and the investigation languished.
sentences.zh: 时间一天天过去，调查陷入了停滞。

sentences.en: By January 1974, ten months had gone by with no major breakthroughs.
sentences.zh: 到了1974年1月，十个月过去了，依然没有取得重大突破。

sentences.en: A coronial inquest was held, but nothing significant was uncovered.
sentences.zh: 虽然举行了验尸研讯，但没有发现任何有价值的线索。

sentences.en: The largest base of the Royal
sentences.zh: 皇家澳大利亚

sentences.en: Australian Air Force is located in Amberley, a suburb 13 kilometres west of Ipswich.
sentences.zh: 空军最大的基地位于安伯利，这是一个位于伊普斯威奇以西13公里的郊区。

sentences.en: Over 5,000 people are employed there, many of whom live on site.
sentences.zh: 那里有5000多名员工，其中许多人住在基地里。

sentences.en: In the early 1980s, female members were housed separately in a double-storey cream brick unit block.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪80年代初，女性军官被安排住在单独的两层米色砖砌宿舍楼里。

sentences.en: On the morning of February 4, 1982, they awoke to a crude surprise.
sentences.zh: 1982年2月4日清早，她们在一个恶劣的惊吓中醒来。

sentences.en: Overnight, someone had scaled up the drainpipe on the side of the building and broken in via an open window, leaving men's boot prints on the wall in the process.
sentences.zh: 就在夜里，有人顺着建筑物侧面的排水管爬上来，从一扇开着的窗户闯了进来，并在墙上留下了男士靴子的足迹。

sentences.en: They then entered one of the women's dorm rooMs.
sentences.zh: 接着他们进入了其中一间女性宿舍。

sentences.en: One of the sleeping women had photographs of herself sitting at her bedhead.
sentences.zh: 其中一名正在睡觉的女性床头放着她自己的照片。

sentences.en: In them, she was wearing revealing clothing.
sentences.zh: 照片里的她穿着暴露的衣服。

sentences.en: The prowler quietly gathered the photos, careful not to make a sound.
sentences.zh: 这个潜入者悄悄地搜集了这些照片，小心翼翼得没有发出一点声音。

sentences.en: He skulked around in the dark, collecting several pairs of women's underwear and Air Force uniforMs. The communal laundry room was located on the ground floor.
sentences.zh: 他在黑暗中鬼鬼祟祟地四处搜寻，收集了几条女性内衣和空军制服。公共洗衣房设在一楼。

sentences.en: There, the prowler took his loot and laid it out on an ironing board.
sentences.zh: 在那里，潜入者拿着他的战利品，把它们铺在烫衣板上。

sentences.en: He slashed the crotches of the underwear and cut holes from the nipple section of the bras.
sentences.zh: 他割破了内衣的裆部，并在胸罩的乳头部位剪了洞。

sentences.en: He did the same thing to the uniforms, before debasing the stolen photographs and fleeing into the night.
sentences.zh: 他对制服也做了同样的处理，随后玷污了被盗的照片，然后逃入了夜色中。

sentences.en: When residents of the unit block discovered the scene the next morning, they were horrified by the violation.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，当宿舍楼的居民发现这一幕时，她们对这种侵犯感到震惊。

sentences.en: Military police were notified immediately.
sentences.zh: 军警立刻得到了通报。

sentences.en: Two officers had been patrolling the airbase in the early hours of the morning and had noticed that a car had been parked near the boundary fence surrounding the women's quarters.
sentences.zh: 两名警官在清晨巡视空军基地时，注意到女性宿舍周围的边界围栏附近停着一辆车。

sentences.en: Noting it as out of place, they'd written down the registration number.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得这辆车停得很不是地方，于是记下了车牌号。

sentences.en: It now seemed very possible that whoever owned this vehicle was responsible for the perverted brake and enter.
sentences.zh: 现在看来，这辆车的车主极有可能就是这起变态的入室盗窃案的罪魁祸首。

sentences.en: Officers checked the Air Force records and quickly identified its owner.
sentences.zh: 警官们查阅了空军档案，很快锁定了车主。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 《罪案档案》稍后回归。

sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的赞助商，感谢您的支持。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您也是在支持《罪案档案》继续为您带来优质的内容。

sentences.en: 26-year-old Raymond Carroll was an electrical fitter who lived on the Amberley Base with his wife and two young daughters.
sentences.zh: 26岁的雷蒙德·卡罗尔是一名电气装配工，他和妻子以及两个年幼的女儿住在安伯利基地。

sentences.en: A member of the Air Force since the age of 17, he'd followed in the footsteps of his late father, a military man who had moved his family to various postings across Australia.
sentences.zh: 他自17岁起便加入空军，追随了他已故父亲的脚步，他的父亲曾是一名军人，带着家人搬迁到澳大利亚各地的驻地。

sentences.en: Police questioned Raymond Carroll about why his car was parked near the women's quarters in the early hours of February 4.
sentences.zh: 警方就2月4日清晨其汽车为何停在女性宿舍附近一事对雷蒙德·卡罗尔进行了讯问。

sentences.en: Carroll said they were mistaken.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔说他们弄错了。

sentences.en: There had been a function at the golf club earlier that evening.
sentences.zh: 那天傍晚早些时候，高尔夫俱乐部曾举办过一场活动。

sentences.en: He'd attended the event but was home before midnight.
sentences.zh: 他参加了那场活动，但在午夜前就回家了。

sentences.en: Carroll's wife backed this up, saying her husband was home by 11.30 and didn't leave the house again.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔的妻子证实了这一点，称她丈夫在11点半前就到家了，之后再也没有离开过家。

sentences.en: The prowler had left fingerprints on the photographs found in the women's laundry room.
sentences.zh: 潜入者在女性洗衣房发现的照片上留下了指纹。

sentences.en: Police obtained Carroll's prints and compared the two.
sentences.zh: 警方获取了卡罗尔的指纹，并将两者进行了比对。

sentences.en: It was an indisputable match.
sentences.zh: 这是一个无可辩驳的吻合。

sentences.en: Raymond Carroll claimed he had no idea how his prints ended up on the photos and maintained he had nothing to do with the break and enter.
sentences.zh: 雷蒙德·卡罗尔声称他不知道自己的指纹是如何出现在照片上的，并坚称自己与这起入室盗窃案毫无关系。

sentences.en: With no prior criminal record, it did seem an odd crime for a seemingly respectable married military man.
sentences.zh: 鉴于他没有犯罪前科，对于一个看似正派的已婚军人来说，这确实是一起离奇的罪行。

sentences.en: But for interviewing officer Corporal John Rowley, his encounter with Raymond Carroll had raised a more serious question.
sentences.zh: 但对审讯官员约翰·罗利下士来说，他与雷蒙德·卡罗尔的这次遭遇引发了一个更严重的问题。

sentences.en: Carroll had told Rowley that before joining the Air Force in 1973 he'd lived with his mother in Ipswich.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔告诉罗利，在1973年加入空军之前，他和母亲住在伊普斯威奇。

sentences.en: Their home was on Quarry Lane, just around the corner from Limestone Park.
sentences.zh: 他们的家在采石场巷，就在石灰石公园的拐角处。

sentences.en: This location, coupled with Carroll's apparent fetish for women's underwear, had Rowley thinking about the unsolved murder of baby Deirdre Kennedy.
sentences.zh: 这个地点，再加上卡罗尔对女性内衣的明显恋物癖，让罗利想起了轰动一时的婴儿代尔德·肯尼迪谋杀案。

sentences.en: Although nine years had passed since Deirdre's death, it was a case Rowley could never forget.
sentences.zh: 尽管距离代尔德遇害已经过去了九年，但这起案件罗利永远无法忘怀。

sentences.en: As he spoke with Raymond Carroll, another detail was too obvious to ignore.
sentences.zh: 当他与雷蒙德·卡罗尔交谈时，另一个细节是如此明显，让人无法忽视。

sentences.en: Carroll had a protruding overbite and distinctly crooked front teeth.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔有突出的暴牙，门牙明显是歪的。

sentences.en: Corporal Rowley became fixated on the possibility that Raymond Carroll could have been responsible for
sentences.zh: 罗利下士开始死死盯着雷蒙德·卡罗尔可能需要承担责任的这种可能性

sentences.en: Deirdre Kennedy's murder.
sentences.zh: 代尔德·肯尼迪的谋杀案。

sentences.en: The underwear, the proximity, the unusual dentition, it all seemed to fit.
sentences.zh: 内衣、地理位置、不寻常的牙齿特征，这一切似乎都很吻合。

sentences.en: But as a defence officer, Rowley's resources were limited and he was soon reposted, making it difficult to access any further information.
sentences.zh: 但作为一名国防官员，罗利的资源有限，他很快被重新派驻外地，这使得他很难获取任何进一步的信息。

sentences.en: Six months after interviewing Carroll about the break and enter at Amberley, Rowley was having lunch with an old colleague, Detective Sergeant John Reynolds.
sentences.zh: 在就安伯利入室盗窃案对卡罗尔进行讯问六个月后，罗利正与老同事侦缉中士约翰·雷诺兹共进午餐。

sentences.en: Reynolds had worked on the Deirdre Kennedy investigation from the outset, and like many others who were involved, he continued to be haunted by the case.
sentences.zh: 雷诺兹从一开始就参与了代尔德·肯尼迪案的调查，和许多其他参与者一样，这起案件至今仍令他挥之不去。

sentences.en: Rowley presented Reynolds with his theory that Raymond Carroll could be involved.
sentences.zh: 罗利向雷诺兹提出了他的推论，即雷蒙德·卡罗尔可能牵涉其中。

sentences.en: Detective
sentences.zh: 侦探

sentences.en: Reynolds' interest was immediately piqued.
sentences.zh: 雷诺兹的兴趣立刻被勾了起来。

sentences.en: He was given permission to reopen the case as the lead investigator, but when he started looking into it, he discovered that valuable information had been loSt.
sentences.zh: 他获准作为首席调查员重新调查此案，但当他开始着手调查时，却发现宝贵的信息已经丢失。

sentences.en: In the summer of 1974, the year after Deirdre's murder, floods had ravaged Ipswich.
sentences.zh: 1974年夏天，即代尔德遇害的次年，伊普斯威奇遭遇了洪灾。

sentences.en: Thousands of homes and businesses had been damaged, including the basement of the Ipswich police station, where evidence was stored.
sentences.zh: 数千栋房屋和企业遭到损毁，其中包括存放证据的伊普斯威奇警察局地下室。

sentences.en: Missing from the Deirdre Kennedy file were records of the extensive door knocks that were conducted around Ipswich straight after her murder.
sentences.zh: 代尔德·肯尼迪的档案中丢失了在她遇害后不久在伊普斯威奇各地进行的广泛走访排查记录。

sentences.en: These contained information about every male who was at home on the night that the crime occurred.
sentences.zh: 这些记录包含了案发当晚在家的每一位男性的信息。

sentences.en: Although this was a major setback, one of the most crucial pieces of evidence remained.
sentences.zh: 尽管这是一个重大挫折，但其中最关键的证据之一仍然保存完好。

sentences.en: The photographs depicting the killer's bite mark.
sentences.zh: 那些描绘凶手咬痕的照片。

sentences.en: In 1973, Raymond Carroll had been 17 years old and was living with his mother and younger siblings on Quarry Lane.
sentences.zh: 1973年时，雷蒙德·卡罗尔年仅17岁，他和母亲以及年幼的弟弟妹妹住在采石场巷。

sentences.en: Their home was just 600 metres from the Kennedy's unit on Short Street and just 700 metres from the toilet block at Limestone Park.
sentences.zh: 他们的家距离肯尼迪位于短街的住所仅600米，距离石灰石公园的厕所也只有700米。

sentences.en: If Raymond Carroll was indeed responsible for taking and killing Deirdre, it meant the entire crime could have occurred within a small triangular radius that could be walked
sentences.zh: 如果雷蒙德·卡罗尔确实是绑架并杀害代尔德的凶手，这就意味着整起犯罪可能发生在一个很小的三角形半径内，步行

sentences.en: on foot in under 10 minutes.
sentences.zh: 不到10分钟就能走完。

sentences.en: In October 1983, investigators on the Kennedy case visited the
sentences.zh: 1983年10月，肯尼迪案的调查人员造访了

sentences.en: Air Force Base in Amberley to approach Raymond Carroll for the first time.
sentences.zh: 位于安伯利的空军基地，首次接触雷蒙德·卡罗尔。

sentences.en: They were forthright about their reason for wanting to question him.
sentences.zh: 他们开门见山地说明了想要讯问他的原因。

sentences.en: Carroll said he wasn't even in Queensland at the time that Deirdre Kennedy was murdered.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔说，在代尔德·肯尼迪遇害时，他甚至不在昆士兰州。

sentences.en: He'd enlisted in the Air Force earlier that year and had been completing his basic recruitment training in the small South Australian town of Edinburgh.
sentences.zh: 他当年早些时候参军入伍，当时正在南澳大利亚的小镇爱丁堡完成基础新兵训练。

sentences.en: The ten-week course ran from February 9 until April 19, after which Carroll said he travelled to the
sentences.zh: 这个为期十周的课程从2月9日一直持续到4月19日，此后卡罗尔说他前往了

sentences.en: Wagga Wagga Air Force Base in New South Wales to undergo electrical training.
sentences.zh: 新南威尔士州的沃加沃加空军基地接受电工培训。

sentences.en: At no time did he return to
sentences.zh: 他从未在任何时间返回过

sentences.en: Whipswitch.
sentences.zh: 惠普斯威奇。

sentences.en: Carroll insisted he had nothing to hide.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔坚称自己没有什么好隐瞒的。

sentences.en: Although he was reluctant, he agreed to provide fingerprints, hair samples and a plaster cast of his teeth.
sentences.zh: 尽管他有些不情愿，但他还是同意提供指纹、头发样本以及牙齿的石膏模型。

sentences.en: A forensic expert deemed that Carroll's hair was of similar colour and texture to the hairs found on Deirdre's body, but in the days before DNA
sentences.zh: 法医专家认为，卡罗尔的头发颜色和质地与在代尔德尸体上发现的头发相似，但在DNA

sentences.en: profiling, there was nothing to conclusively say the hairs belonged to Carroll.
sentences.zh: 分析技术问世之前的日子里，没有任何证据可以确凿地说明这些头发属于卡罗尔。

sentences.en: Investigators compared the fingerprints with those found at the Kennedy's flat as well as the toilet block at
sentences.zh: 调查人员将这些指纹与在肯尼迪公寓以及

sentences.en: Limestone Park.
sentences.zh: 石灰石公园的厕所里发现的指纹进行了比对。

sentences.en: They didn't match.
sentences.zh: 它们并不匹配。

sentences.en: Then again, it couldn't be determined for certain that the prints found at the crime scenes definitely belonged to the perpetrator.
sentences.zh: 话又说回来，无法确凿断定在犯罪现场发现的指纹一定属于作案者。

sentences.en: The toilet block in
sentences.zh: 位于

sentences.en: Limestone Park was a public space, and it was possible that the prints had been made by an innocent community member.
sentences.zh: 石灰石公园的公厕是一个公共场所，这些指纹也有可能是由某个无辜的社区成员留下的。

sentences.en: The print on the Kennedy's front door could have come from any number of people who had visited the unit in recent times.
sentences.zh: 肯尼迪家前门上的指纹可能来自最近访问过该公寓的形形色色的人中的任何一个。

sentences.en: Then there was the issue of Carroll's alibi.
sentences.zh: 接下来是卡罗尔的不在场证明问题。

sentences.en: Air Force records confirmed that Carroll had indeed graduated from the training course in Edinburgh on April 19, 1973.
sentences.zh: 空军档案证实，卡罗尔确实于1973年4月19日在爱丁堡完成了培训课程并顺利毕业。

sentences.en: Recruits were only granted leave under special circumstances, typically for a serious family emergency.
sentences.zh: 新兵只有在特殊情况下才会获准请假，通常是针对严重的家庭紧急情况。

sentences.en: Doing so required them to go through a strict approval process.
sentences.zh: 这样做需要他们通过严格的审批流程。

sentences.en: The Air Force had no record of Carroll leaving the training course at any point.
sentences.zh: 空军没有关于卡罗尔在任何时间离开过培训课程的记录。

sentences.en: A formal graduation parade had taken place in Edinburgh on April 19, 1973, after which the recruits had all posed for a course photograph.
sentences.zh: 1973年4月19日，爱丁堡举行了一场正式的毕业阅兵式，之后新兵们合影留念。

sentences.en: Raymond Carroll had already told the police that he'd attended the ceremony, but hadn't walked in the parade due to an issue with the number of recruits.
sentences.zh: 雷蒙德·卡罗尔此前已经告诉警方他参加了典礼，但由于新兵人数的问题，他没有参加阅兵式。

sentences.en: Investigators made queries with Air Force officials who confirmed that all graduates were required to march in the parade regardless of numbers.
sentences.zh: 调查人员向空军官员进行了查询，对方证实所有毕业生都必须参加阅兵式，无论人数多少。

sentences.en: They obtained the graduation photo.
sentences.zh: 他们获取了毕业照。

sentences.en: Raymond Carroll was nowhere to be seen.
sentences.zh: 照片里根本不见雷蒙德·卡罗尔的身影。

sentences.en: Investigators began the monumental task of trying to track down each of the 27 recruits from Carroll's course, who were now scattered across the country.
sentences.zh: 调查人员开始了一项艰巨的任务，试图追踪分散在全国各地的卡罗尔同期的27名新兵。

sentences.en: They wanted to know if anyone was absent from the graduation ceremony.
sentences.zh: 他们想知道是否有人缺席了毕业典礼。

sentences.en: By this point, over ten years had passed and memories were hazy.
sentences.zh: 此时，十多年已经过去，记忆已经变得模糊。

sentences.en: No one could recall any specifics, but there was a vague recollection that someone had left early due to an illness in the family.
sentences.zh: 没有人能回忆起具体细节，但有一个模糊的记忆，即有人因为家人生病而提前离开。

sentences.en: According to the book Justice in Jeopardy, one recruit recalled that on the afternoon of April 12,
sentences.zh: 根据《处于危险中的正义》一书，一名新兵回忆说，在1973年4月12日

sentences.en: 1973, he was asked to help pack up the belongings of another rookie who'd been called home on compassionate leave.
sentences.zh: 的下午，他被要求帮忙收拾另一名因家中有急事而被召回的新兵的行李。

sentences.en: He remembered the young man clearly because he had a distinct set of teeth that jutted out.
sentences.zh: 他对这个年轻人印象深刻，因为他有一口向前突出的标志性牙齿。

sentences.en: His name was Raymond Carroll.
sentences.zh: 他的名字叫雷蒙德·卡罗尔。

sentences.en: Investigators couldn't find any Air Force records to back up the claims that Carroll had been granted leave.
sentences.zh: 调查人员找不到任何空军记录来支持卡罗尔曾获准请假的说法。

sentences.en: Nor were there any medical records to indicate there had been a serious illness within his family that would have warranted him returning home.
sentences.zh: 也没有任何医疗记录表明他的家族曾发生过需要他返回家中的重大疾病。

sentences.en: Instead, investigators turned to the commercial airlines.
sentences.zh: 于是，调查人员转而求助于商业航空公司。

sentences.en: There were 2000 kilometres between
sentences.zh: 爱丁堡和伊普斯威奇之间相距

sentences.en: Edinburgh and Ipswich.
If Carroll had been granted leave on April 12, the only way he would have made it to Ipswich in time to kill Deirdre Kennedy on April 13 was if he'd flown.
sentences.zh: 如果卡罗尔在4月12日获准请假，他唯一能赶在4月13日及时到达伊普斯威奇杀害代尔德·肯尼迪的方式就是坐飞机。

sentences.en: But the airlines were no use.
sentences.zh: 但航空公司也帮不上忙。

sentences.en: Protocol dictated that domestic records be disposed of after seven years.
sentences.zh: 规定要求国内航班记录在七年后销毁。

sentences.en: Disproving Raymond Carroll's alibi wasn't the only issue.
sentences.zh: 推翻雷蒙德·卡罗尔的不在场证明并不是唯一的问题。

sentences.en: The prowler who had been witness lurking around the Kennedy's unit on the night of Deirdre's abduction
sentences.zh: 代尔德被绑架当晚，曾在肯尼迪家住房周围鬼鬼祟祟窥探的潜入者

sentences.en: was described as being around 172 centimetres tall with collar length light brown to blonde hair.
sentences.zh: 据描述身高约172厘米，留着及领的浅棕色到金色头发。

sentences.en: In April 1973, Raymond Carroll's hair was dark brown and, as per Air Force protocol, it was cropped short at the back and sides.
sentences.zh: 1973年4月，雷蒙德·卡罗尔的头发是深棕色的，并且按照空军规定，后脑勺和两侧的头发都剪得很短。

sentences.en: He was much taller than the prowler, standing around 185 centimetres.
sentences.zh: 他比那个潜入者高得多，身高大约185厘米。

sentences.en: Investigators believed they'd found Deirdre's killer, but they'd need further evidence if a jury was ever going to find Carroll guilty.
sentences.zh: 调查人员认为他们已经找到了迪尔德丽的凶手，但如果要让陪审团裁定卡罗尔有罪，他们还需要进一步的证据。

sentences.en: They had to dig deeper.
sentences.zh: 他们必须深入挖掘。

sentences.en: Joy Myers had been a young and naive woman when she met Raymond Carroll in
sentences.zh: 乔伊·迈尔斯在1973年于

sentences.en: Wagga Wagga in 1973.
sentences.zh: 沃加沃加结识雷蒙德·卡罗尔时，还是一名年轻而天真的女子。

sentences.en: The two married and had their first child the following year, a daughter named
sentences.zh: 两人结婚了，并在第二年迎来了他们的第一个孩子，一个名叫

sentences.en: Kylie, not her real name.
sentences.zh: 凯莉的女儿（化名）。

sentences.en: Carroll was reposted to Darwin and the family of three relocated.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔被调职到达尔文，三口之家随之搬迁。

sentences.en: But the marriage was rocky from the beginning and it wasn't long before Joy suspected that Carroll was cheating on her.
sentences.zh: 但这段婚姻从一开始就磕磕绊绊，没过多久，乔伊就开始怀疑卡罗尔出轨。

sentences.en: The couple divorced in November of 1975 and had little contact from there on, with Joy maintaining full custody of Kylie.
sentences.zh: 两人于1975年11月离婚，此后联系甚少，凯莉的抚养权完全归乔伊所有。

sentences.en: Investigators tracked Joy down and questioned her about the marriage.
sentences.zh: 调查人员找到了乔伊并就这段婚姻对她进行了盘问。

sentences.en: What she told them was shocking.
sentences.zh: 她所说的话令人震惊。

sentences.en: When Kylie was just a baby, there had been four or five occasions where Raymond Carroll had taken her into the bedroom to change her nappy.
sentences.zh: 在凯莉还是个婴儿的时候，雷蒙德·卡罗尔曾有四五次把她抱进卧室换尿布。

sentences.en: Shortly after, Kylie would start screaming.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，凯莉就会开始放声大哭。

sentences.en: Joy went to see what was wrong, but on each occasion, Carroll had locked the door and refused to respond.
sentences.zh: 乔伊前去查看出了什么问题，但每次卡罗尔都把门锁上，拒绝回应。

sentences.en: He'd emerged shortly after with a strange expression on his face, before leaving the house without saying a word.
sentences.zh: 他不久后从房间出来，脸上带着奇怪的表情，随后一言不发地离开了家。

sentences.en: Kylie was too young to talk, but the bruises on her upper thighs spoke for themselves.
sentences.zh: 凯莉还小，不会说话，但她大腿上方的淤青却说明了一切。

sentences.en: Joy believed them to be bite marks.
sentences.zh: 乔伊认为那是咬痕。

sentences.en: She said this abuse was one of the reasons she divorced Carroll.
sentences.zh: 她说这种虐待是她与卡罗尔离婚的原因之一。

sentences.en: When the investigators divulged the reason why they were making enquiries about her ex-husband, Joy had another revelation.
sentences.zh: 当调查人员透露他们询问其前夫原因时，乔伊又有了一个惊人的发现。

sentences.en: When the newlyweds had first found out they were expecting a child, Carroll had an idea for a name.
sentences.zh: 这对新婚夫妇刚发现即将迎来孩子时，卡罗尔就想好了一个名字。

sentences.en: If it was a girl, he wanted to call her Deidre.
sentences.zh: 如果是女孩，他想给她取名叫迪尔德丽。

sentences.en: Raymond Carroll remarried in 1977, and he and his new wife went on to have twin daughters.
sentences.zh: 雷蒙德·卡罗尔于1977年再婚，他和新婚妻子随后生了一对双胞胎女儿。

sentences.en: By the time Carroll became the focus of the
sentences.zh: 当卡罗尔成为

sentences.en: Deidre Kennedy murder investigation, he and his wife had also welcomed a baby boy.
sentences.zh: 迪尔德丽·肯尼迪谋杀案的调查焦点时，他和妻子还迎来了一个小儿子。

sentences.en: Police knew some of the evidence against Carroll was flimsy, but the plaster cast of Raymond Carroll's teeth was examined by a forensic dental expert.
sentences.zh: 警方知道针对卡罗尔的一些证据并不充分，但法医牙科专家对雷蒙德·卡罗尔的牙齿石膏模型进行了检验。

sentences.en: He compared the dental impressions with photos of the bruises on
sentences.zh: 他将牙齿印模与

sentences.en: Deidre Kennedy's thigh.
sentences.zh: 迪尔德丽·肯尼迪大腿上淤青的照片进行了比对。

sentences.en: The positioning of the bruises lined up with Raymond Carroll's unique overbite, and was a fitting size for a 17-year-old male.
sentences.zh: 淤青的位置与雷蒙德·卡罗尔独特的深覆颌吻合，且尺寸大小适合一名17岁的男性。

sentences.en: But the shape of the bruises indicated the killer's front two teeth were slightly deformed.
sentences.zh: 但淤青的形状表明凶手的前两颗牙齿有些畸形。

sentences.en: The plaster cast of Carroll's teeth showed no such deformity.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔的牙齿石膏模型并没有显示出这种畸形。

sentences.en: Investigators obtained a copy of Carroll's dental records from the Air Force, which were taken during his recruitment in early 1973.
sentences.zh: 调查人员从空军获取了一份卡罗尔的牙医档案复印件，该档案拍摄于1973年初他入伍期间。

sentences.en: Comparing the records to the plaster cast, it appeared his upper teeth had since undergone some dental work.
sentences.zh: 将档案与石膏模型进行比对，发现他的上牙在此之后似乎做过一些牙科手术。

sentences.en: The 1973 records showed that at the time of Deidre Kennedy's murder, Raymond Carroll's front teeth were chipped and broken – deformities that matched the bruises on Deidre's body.
sentences.zh: 1973年的档案显示，在迪尔德丽·肯尼迪遇害时，雷蒙德·卡罗尔的前牙有缺损和断裂——这些畸形与迪尔德丽身上的淤青相吻合。

sentences.en: For the dental expert, there was no question.
sentences.zh: 对牙科专家来说，毫无疑问。

sentences.en: The bite marks on the baby had been made by Raymond Carroll.
sentences.zh: 婴儿身上的咬痕就是雷蒙德·卡罗尔留下的。

sentences.en: But if Deidre Kennedy had been killed on April 13 at a time Carroll was supposed to be interstate, how did his teeth marks end up on her body?
sentences.zh: 但如果迪尔德丽·肯尼迪是在4月13日遇害的，而当时卡罗尔本应在跨州，他的牙印怎么会出现在她身上？

sentences.en: Was it possible that the Air Force records were wrong?
sentences.zh: 难道空军档案会出错吗？

sentences.en: On February 27, 1984, two years after the break-in at the Amberley women's quarters and almost eleven years after Deidre was killed, investigators
sentences.zh: 1984年2月27日，即安伯利女子宿舍入室盗窃案发生两年后，也是迪尔德丽被害近十一年后，调查人员

sentences.en: decided it was time to make their move.
sentences.zh: 决定采取行动。

sentences.en: They went to the Amberley base and placed Raymond Carroll under arrest for murdering the seventeen-month-old.
sentences.zh: 他们前往安伯利基地，以谋杀这名十七个月大婴儿的罪名将雷蒙德·卡罗尔逮捕。

sentences.en: Carroll continued to deny any involvement in the crime.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔坚决否认自己与这起犯罪有任何牵连。

sentences.en: He maintained he was in South Australia at the time and stuck by his story that he didn't participate in the graduation march but was present for the duration.
sentences.zh: 他坚称自己当时在南澳大利亚州，并坚持说自己没有参加毕业阅兵，但在整个期间都在场。

sentences.en: When shown the graduation photo of his fellow recruits, Carroll first pointed to a young man who looked nothing like him and said it was possible that was him.
sentences.zh: 当被出示同届新兵的毕业合影时，卡罗尔先是指着一个长相跟他完全不像的年轻男子，说那个人可能是他。

sentences.en: He then conceded that he wasn't in the shot but explained that he was standing to the side, just outside of the frame.
sentences.zh: 随后他又承认自己不在照片里，但解释说自己当时站在旁边，刚好在画框外面。

sentences.en: He denied ever being granted special leave or having any reason to leave the training course early to return to Whipswitch.
sentences.zh: 他否认自己曾获得过特许假期，也否认有任何理由提前离开训练课程返回威普斯威奇。

sentences.en: He also denied his ex-wife's allegations that he'd abused their first daughter or that he had a proclivity for stealing women's underwear.
sentences.zh: 他还否认了前妻关于他虐待他们的大女儿以及他有偷窃女性内衣癖好的指控。

sentences.en: The interrogation continued for several hours but at no point did Raymond Carroll crack.
sentences.zh: 审讯持续了几个小时，但雷蒙德·卡罗尔始终没有崩溃。

sentences.en: Regardless, he was officially charged with the murder of Deirdre Kennedy.

sentences.en: Using this new technology, a team of forensic experts analysed the bruises on Deirdre Kennedy's body.
