sentences.en: They discovered another set of much fainter bite marks on
sentences.zh: 他们在……上发现了另一组更为模糊的咬痕

sentences.en: Deirdre's body that had been missed during the original examination.
sentences.zh: 德尔德丽的尸体上，这些咬痕在最初的检查中被忽略了。

sentences.en: The assumption had always been that Deirdre was lying down when she was bitten and that the top bruise on her thigh had been caused by the biter's upper teeth.
sentences.zh: 以往的假设一直是，德尔德丽遇咬时是躺着的，她大腿上的上方淤青是由咬人的上牙造成的。

sentences.en: According to the book Justice in Jeopardy, the new evidence indicated this was wrong.
sentences.zh: 根据《在危险中的正义》一书，新证据表明这一推断是错误的。

sentences.en: Deirdre had actually been held upside down when the biter struck.
sentences.zh: 事实上，当咬人者行凶时，德尔德丽是被倒提着悬空的。

sentences.en: The original experts who had given evidence at Carroll's trial had been looking at the bite marks the wrong way around.
sentences.zh: 在卡罗尔的审判中提供证据的原始专家把咬痕的方向看反了。

sentences.en: While this was a major revelation, one piece of evidence remained undisputed.
sentences.zh: 虽然这是一个重大发现，但有一项证据仍然无可争议。

sentences.en: As forensic odontologist Dr Alex Forrest later told Australian Story,
sentences.zh: 正如法医齿科专家亚历克斯·福雷斯特博士后来在《澳大利亚故事》节目中所说的那样：

sentences.en: The bite marks that were inflicted on the baby's thigh, I have no doubt whatever that they were inflicted by Raymond John Carroll.
sentences.zh: “留在婴儿大腿上的咬痕，我毫无疑问地认为，它们就是由雷蒙德·约翰·卡罗尔造成的。”

sentences.en: An article spruiking the forensic advances led to renewed interest in the Deirdre Kennedy case and prompted an influx of tip-offs, one of which came from an unexpected source.
sentences.zh: 一篇宣传法医学进展的文章引发了人们对德尔德丽·肯尼迪案的重新关注，并促使大量线索涌入，其中一条线索来自一个意想不到的来源。

sentences.en: 38-year-old Trevor Swift had been in and out of jail all of his adult life for a series of offences.
sentences.zh: 38岁的特雷弗·斯威夫特成年后因多次犯罪而屡次进出监狱。

sentences.en: In February 1984, he was serving time in Brisbane's Boggo Road jail when he crossed paths with Raymond Carroll, who had just been arrested for Deirdre Kennedy's murder.
sentences.zh: 1984年2月，他正在布里斯班的博戈罗德监狱服刑，当时他与雷蒙德·卡罗尔擦肩而过，后者刚刚因谋杀德尔德丽·肯尼迪被捕。

sentences.en: Both men were being held in protective custody.
sentences.zh: 这两名男子都被关押在保护性拘留所中。

sentences.en: According to Swift, he struck up a conversation with Carroll, who asked him,
sentences.zh: 据斯威夫特称，他与卡罗尔搭话，卡罗尔问他：

sentences.en: What do you know about bite marks?
sentences.zh: “你对咬痕了解多少？”

sentences.en: Swift responded,
sentences.zh: 斯威夫特回答道：

sentences.en: Mate, as far as I know, they're as good as fingerprints.
sentences.zh: “伙计，据我所知，它们和指纹一样管用。”

sentences.en: You're a shot duck.
sentences.zh: “你死定了。”

sentences.en: Carroll seemed rattled by Swift's response.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔似乎被斯威夫特的回答吓得有些慌乱。

sentences.en: Some time later, Swift asked Carroll what he'd been arrested for.
sentences.zh: 一段时间后，斯威夫特问卡罗尔他因何被捕。

sentences.en: Carroll allegedly responded,
sentences.zh: 据称卡罗尔回答说：

sentences.en: The murder of that baby at Ipswich.
sentences.zh: “伊普斯威奇那个婴儿的谋杀案。”

sentences.en: A day or so later, Swift pressed Carroll to tell him more.
sentences.zh: 一天左右后，斯威夫特催促卡罗尔告诉他更多细节。

sentences.en: Carroll allegedly said that he'd been out stealing women's underwear when he stumbled upon an open window.
sentences.zh: 据称卡罗尔说，他当时正外出偷窃女性内衣，无意中发现了一扇开着的窗户。

sentences.en: He looked in and saw there was a baby inside.
sentences.zh: 他往里面看去，发现里面有一个婴儿。

sentences.en: Things got out of hand.
sentences.zh: 事情失控了。

sentences.en: He abducted the baby, abused her, and then strangled her with a pair of pantyhose before leaving her body on a toilet block.
sentences.zh: 他劫持了这个婴儿，虐待了她，然后用一条连裤袜将她勒死，最后把她的尸体扔在了一个厕所建筑上。

sentences.en: Swift was relocated to another sector of the prison shortly after this encounter, and then eventually transferred to another facility altogether.
sentences.zh: 这次偶遇后不久，斯威夫特被重新安置到监狱的另一个区，随后彻底转到了另一个设施。

sentences.en: He told one prison guard about what Carroll had said, but never mentioned it to anyone else.
sentences.zh: 他曾向一名狱警讲述过卡罗尔说过的话，但再也没有向其他人提及此事。

sentences.en: He just assumed that Carroll had been convicted of the crime and never gave it much more thought.
sentences.zh: 他只是以为卡罗尔已经因这起罪行而被定罪，之后就再也没多想。

sentences.en: With the case now back in the news, Trevor Swift contacted police and provided an official statement about the alleged confession.
sentences.zh: 随着该案重新登上新闻头条，特雷弗·斯威夫特联系了警方，并就所谓的供词提供了一份正式陈述。

sentences.en: There was just one problem.
sentences.zh: 问题只有一个。

sentences.en: The prison guard he claimed to have told about the encounter had since passed away and there was no one to vouch for Swift's story.
sentences.zh: 他声称曾向其讲述这次偶遇的那名狱警已经去世，因此没有人能为斯威夫特的说法作证。

sentences.en: Swift was currently facing multiple criminal charges.
sentences.zh: 斯威夫特当时正面临多项刑事指控。

sentences.en: Investigators knew that jailhouse confessions can be unreliable and that there was every chance that
sentences.zh: 调查人员深知狱中供词往往不可靠，并且很有可能

sentences.en: Swift was providing this information in the hopes of securing a lighter sentence.
sentences.zh: 斯威夫特提供这些信息是希望获得较轻的刑罚。

sentences.en: At the same time, it was too compelling to ignore.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，这一线索又极具说服力，让人无法忽视。

sentences.en: Despite Raymond Carroll being protected by double jeopardy laws, this new evidence led prosecutors to consider all possible options.
sentences.zh: 尽管雷蒙德·卡罗尔受到双重危险法律的保护，但这一新证据仍促使检方考虑所有可能的选项。

sentences.en: After heavy scrutinising, they identified a potential legal loophole.
sentences.zh: 经过仔细审查，他们找到了一个潜在的法律漏洞。

sentences.en: At Carroll's murder trial, he was asked under oath if he'd killed Deirdre Kennedy.
sentences.zh: 在卡罗尔的谋杀案审判中，他在宣誓后被问及是否杀害了德尔德丽·肯尼迪。

sentences.en: He responded,
sentences.zh: 他回答：

sentences.en: I did not.
sentences.zh: “我没有。”

sentences.en: If the new evidence could prove that he'd knowingly lied under oath when he said he didn't kill Deirdre, prosecutors could charge him with perjury instead.
sentences.zh: 如果新证据能够证明他在说自己没有杀害德尔德丽时是在法庭上明知故犯地撒谎，检方便可以改以伪证罪起诉他。

sentences.en: A perjury conviction only carried a maximum sentence of 14 years' imprisonment, but it would at least provide some form of closure for the
sentences.zh: 伪证罪的最高刑期仅为14年监禁，但这至少能为……提供某种形式的了结

sentences.en: Kennedy family and get a potentially dangerous predator off the streets.
sentences.zh: 肯尼迪一家，并将一个潜在的危险掠夺者赶出社会。

sentences.en: By 1999, 44-year-old Raymond
sentences.zh: 到1999年，44岁的雷蒙德

sentences.en: Carroll had divorced his second wife and was living in Ipswich with his new partner.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔已经与第二任妻子离婚，和新伴侣住在伊普斯威奇。

sentences.en: On Friday February 12, police arrived at Carroll's home and placed him under arrest for perjury.
sentences.zh: 2月12日，星期五，警察来到卡罗尔的家中，以伪证罪将他逮捕。

sentences.en: He was charged at the station later that day but released on bail after being deemed a no-flight risk.
sentences.zh: 他当天晚些时候在警察局被起诉，但由于被认为没有潜逃风险而获准保释。

sentences.en: Carroll's legal team argued that the new charge constituted an abusive process and they requested a permanent stay in the proceedings.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔的法律团队辩称，这项新指控构成了对诉讼程序的滥用，并请求永久中止诉讼程序。

sentences.en: The judge disagreed, saying the prosecution case was significantly different and stronger than the original murder charge.
sentences.zh: 法官并不同意，称检方的证据与最初的谋杀指控有很大不同且更有力。

sentences.en: Carroll was ordered to stand trial for perjury.
sentences.zh: 法官下令对卡罗尔因伪证罪进行审判。

sentences.en: Investigators were now armed with new dental evidence and a jailhouse confession, but doubts remained that this would be enough to secure a conviction.
sentences.zh: 调查人员现在手头有了新的牙科学证据和狱中供词，但人们仍然怀疑这是否足以定罪。

sentences.en: One of the lingering questions was, if Raymond Carroll was indeed in Ipswich at the time of
sentences.zh: 挥之不去的疑问之一是，如果雷蒙德·卡罗尔在……时确实在伊普斯威奇

sentences.en: Deirdre Kennedy's murder, what was he doing wandering around late at night?
sentences.zh: 德尔德丽·肯尼迪遇害时，他大半夜在外面闲逛在干什么？

sentences.en: He was only 17 and there weren't any shops open in the area.
sentences.zh: 他当时才17岁，附近也没有任何商店开门。

sentences.en: Investigators wondered if he could have been out visiting a friend, or more likely,
sentences.zh: 调查人员想知道他是不是出门拜访朋友，或者更可能是，

sentences.en: a love intereSt. Desley Hill had been a teenager when she and Raymond Carroll began a short romance in 1972.
sentences.zh: 一个心上人。1972年德斯莉·希尔与雷蒙德·卡罗尔开始了一段短暂的恋情时，还是一名十几岁的少女。

sentences.en: They maintained contact for a couple of years, even after Carroll married his first wife, but things eventually fizzled out between them and they lost touch.
sentences.zh: 他们保持了几年联系，甚至在卡罗尔与第一任妻子结婚后也是如此，但最终两人的感情渐渐淡去，失去了联系。

sentences.en: Desley moved interstate and rarely thought about her distant ex, until March of 2000 when she opened her door to find a detective standing there.
sentences.zh: 德斯莉搬到了外州，几乎不再想起她那位疏远的旧情人，直到2000年3月她打开门，发现门口站着一名侦探。

sentences.en: He wanted to speak to her about her relationship with Raymond Carroll.
sentences.zh: 他想就她与雷蒙德·卡罗尔的关系找她谈谈。

sentences.en: Desley was taken aback.
sentences.zh: 德斯莉大吃一惊。

sentences.en: She knew Carroll had been charged with Deirdre Kennedy's murder back in the 80s, but it never occurred to her that she could be of any use to the investigation.
sentences.zh: 她知道卡罗尔早在80年代就被指控谋杀德尔德丽，但她从未想过自己会对这项调查有什么用处。

sentences.en: The detective tried to jog her memory back to April 1973.
sentences.zh: 侦探试图唤醒她对1973年4月的记忆。

sentences.en: Could she recall whether Carroll had visited her at any point during that time?
sentences.zh: 她是否还记得卡罗尔在那段时间里的任何时候拜访过她？

sentences.en: Desley had been living with her parents in Woodridge at the time, a suburb 37 kilometres east of Ipswich.
sentences.zh: 德斯莉当时和父母住在伍德里奇，那是伊普斯威奇以东37公里的一个郊区。

sentences.en: She recalled that out of nowhere one Saturday night,
sentences.zh: 她回忆起在一个周六的晚上，毫无征兆地，

sentences.en: Raymond Carroll had stopped by their unit.
sentences.zh: 雷蒙德·卡罗尔顺道来到了他们的公寓。

sentences.en: They hadn't seen each other for a while and Desley was shocked to see him.
sentences.zh: 他们已经有一段时间没见了，德斯莉对他的到来感到十分震惊。

sentences.en: While they stood around chatting, a news bulletin came on about Deirdre Kennedy's murder.
sentences.zh: 正当他们站在那里闲聊时，广播里播报了一条关于德尔德丽·肯尼迪遇害的新闻快讯。

sentences.en: Her body had only been found early that morning.
sentences.zh: 她的尸体是在当天清早才被发现的。

sentences.en: Carroll became visibly agitated.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔明显变得焦躁不安。

sentences.en: He left in a hurry, saying he had to get home to his sick mother.
sentences.zh: 他匆忙离开，说他得赶回家去看望生病的母亲。

sentences.en: The perjury trial commenced on October 27, 2000.
sentences.zh: 伪证案审判于2000年10月27日正式开庭。

sentences.en: It was essentially a replay of the original murder trial, with a majority of the same witnesses called and testimonies given.
sentences.zh: 这基本上是最初谋杀案审判的重演，大部分相同的证人被传唤并提供了证词。

sentences.en: The new evidence submitted was the alleged jailhouse confession, the statement from Desley Hill that placed Carroll in Queensland the day after Deirdre's murder, and the advanced
sentences.zh: 提交的新证据包括所谓的狱中供词、德斯莉·希尔的陈述（证明卡罗尔在德尔德丽遇害的第二天身处昆士兰州），以及

sentences.en: dental forensics that matched Carroll's teeth with the bite marks on Deirdre's body.
sentences.zh: 将卡罗尔的牙齿与德尔德丽尸体上的咬痕进行匹配的高级牙科法医学证据。

sentences.en: The defence urged the jury not to place any weight on the jailhouse confession from Trevor Swift.
sentences.zh: 辩方敦促陪审团不要重视来自特雷弗·斯威夫特的狱中供词。

sentences.en: He was an alcoholic with an extensive criminal history that included dishonesty, and they contended that the information he provided
sentences.zh: 他是一个嗜酒如命的人，有着广泛的犯罪记录，其中包括不诚实行为，他们辩称他提供的信息

sentences.en: was nothing more than an attempt to secure a lighter sentence for his own crimes.
sentences.zh: 不过是企图为自己的罪行争取较轻判决的伎俩。

sentences.en: Swift strongly denied this.
sentences.zh: 斯威夫特对此坚决予以否认。

sentences.en: He was well aware that informants put themselves in danger of being attacked by other inmates.
sentences.zh: 他非常清楚，作为线人，他们将自己置于遭到其他囚犯袭击的危险境地。

sentences.en: He also pointed out that he'd been in constant trouble with the law his entire adult life.
sentences.zh: 他还指出，他整个成年人生涯中一直麻烦不断。

sentences.en: If he was going to make up a story to benefit himself, he would have done it much earlier.
sentences.zh: 如果他要编造一个对对自己有利的故事，他早就这么做了。

sentences.en: Why wait 16 years?
sentences.zh: 为什么要等上16年？

sentences.en: Carroll's ex-girlfriend Desley Hill took the stand to testify that Carroll had visited her parents' home the day after
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔的前女友德斯莉·希尔出庭作证称，卡罗尔在……的第二天曾拜访过她父母的家

sentences.en: Deirdre was killed.
sentences.zh: 德尔德丽被杀害。

sentences.en: At the time, Desley had been pregnant to a man who ended the relationship once he found out she was expecting.
sentences.zh: 当时，德斯莉正怀着一个男人的孩子，那个男人一发现她怀孕就结束了这段关系。

sentences.en: A couple of months later, Desley started seeing Raymond Carroll again.
sentences.zh: 几个月后，德斯莉开始再次与雷蒙德·卡罗尔交往。

sentences.en: Desley remembered the day that Carroll visited her parents' house because she'd been waiting for a cot to be delivered.
sentences.zh: 德斯莉记得卡罗尔拜访她父母家那天，因为她一直在等一张婴儿床送货。

sentences.en: Although she admitted she wasn't good with dates, she could place the visit to April 14, 1973, based on the news broadcast about Deirdre Kennedy's murder.
sentences.zh: 尽管她承认自己记性不好，但根据关于德尔德丽·肯尼迪谋杀案的新闻广播，她能将那次拜访的时间锁定在1973年4月14日。

sentences.en: Desley's parents had been home at the time, but they couldn't back her story.
sentences.zh: 德斯莉的父母当时在家，但他们无法证实她的说法。

sentences.en: Both had since passed away.
sentences.zh: 两人此后都已离世。

sentences.en: The defence called Desley's story a complete fabrication.
sentences.zh: 辩方称德斯莉的故事纯属捏造。

sentences.en: Desley couldn't remember the date that her daughter was conceived, but the child was born on July 25, 1973, and was 10 weeks premature.
sentences.zh: 德斯莉记不清女儿受孕的具体日期，但这个孩子出生于1973年7月25日，早产了10周。

sentences.en: The defence pointed out that this meant Desley had gotten pregnant in early
sentences.zh: 辩方指出，这意味着德斯莉是在……初怀孕的

sentences.en: January of 1973 and wouldn't have found out until mid-February.
sentences.zh: 1973年1月，直到2月中旬才发现自己怀孕。

sentences.en: By the time she claimed to have resumed her relationship with Raymond Carroll, he had already enrolled in the Air Force and been deployed interstate.
sentences.zh: 到她声称自己与雷蒙德·卡罗尔恢复恋情时，他已经加入空军并被派往外州服役。

sentences.en: Therefore, her memory of the timings was all wrong.
sentences.zh: 因此，她对时间的记忆完全是错误的。

sentences.en: The visit, they said, never happened.
sentences.zh: 他们说，这次探访根本就没有发生过。

sentences.en: Four separate odontologists testified that the bite marks on Deirdre Kennedy's body were a match to
sentences.zh: 四位不同的齿科专家作证说，德尔德丽·肯尼迪尸体上的咬痕与

sentences.en: Raymond Carroll.
sentences.zh: 雷蒙德·卡罗尔相吻合。

sentences.en: They all agreed that the experts had it wrong during the first trial, in that they'd been looking at the bite marks upside down.
sentences.zh: 他们一致认为，在第一次审判中专家们搞错了，因为他们把咬痕的方向看倒了。

sentences.en: The defence argued that the digital imaging technology wasn't accurate and that testimony provided by some of the experts was fundamentally flawed.
sentences.zh: 辩方则辩称，数字成像技术并不准确，部分专家提供的证词存在根本性的缺陷。

sentences.en: A doctor of forensic dentistry who had been involved with over 200 bite mark cases testified that the
sentences.zh: 一位曾参与过200多起咬痕案件的法医牙科学博士作证说，

sentences.en: bruises on Deirdre's body weren't enough to make a positive identification of the biter.
sentences.zh: 德尔德丽尸体上的淤青不足以对咬人者作出明确的身份鉴定。

sentences.en: While the digital imaging technique was very useful, this expert said it should only be used as an aid in dental analysis and not as a means of identification.
sentences.zh: 这位专家表示，虽然数字成像技术非常有用，但它只能用作牙科分析的辅助手段，而不能作为鉴定的依据。

sentences.en: The defence questioned whether the bite could have in fact been made by Barry Kennedy's cousin, Keith Kennedy.
sentences.zh: 辩方质疑这个咬痕实际上是否可能是由巴里·肯尼迪的表弟基思·肯尼迪造成的。

sentences.en: Keith also had a distinct set of teeth and more closely matched the physical description of the blonde man seen lurking around the Kennedy's unit on the night of the crime.
sentences.zh: 基思也有一口独特的牙齿，并且在体貌特征上更符合案发当晚在肯尼迪夫妇公寓附近徘徊的金发男子。

sentences.en: Keith had passed away, but the dental experts could tell just by looking at a photograph of his gapped teeth that his bite was not a match to the bruises on Deirdre's body.
sentences.zh: 基思已经去世，但牙科专家仅通过观察他牙齿有缝隙的照片就可以看出，他的咬合与德尔德丽尸体上的淤青并不匹配。

sentences.en: Faye and Barry Kennedy had chosen not to sit through the first trial, but they were present for the perjury case.
sentences.zh: 费伊和巴里·肯尼迪没有选择出席第一次庭审，但他们出席了伪证案的庭审。

sentences.en: Hearing the forensic experts go back and forth over what had happened to Deirdre was too much for the Kennedys to bear.
sentences.zh: 听着法医专家们就德尔德丽遭遇的不幸争论不休，这对肯尼迪夫妇来说实在是难以承受。

sentences.en: Faye later told Australian Story,
sentences.zh: 费伊后来在《澳大利亚故事》节目中说：

sentences.en: All I could think was she was so little, and for someone to do something so atrocious to her and to
sentences.zh: “我脑子里想的全是她还那么小，居然有人对她做出如此残暴的事情，还要……

sentences.en: discard her little body, just to throw her on a toilet block like she was just trash.
sentences.zh: 抛弃她的小身体，就像扔垃圾一样把她扔在厕所建筑上。”

sentences.en: The perjury trial lasted for 18 days.
sentences.zh: 伪证案审判持续了18天。

sentences.en: Given the amount of time that had passed since Deirdre's murder, the judge instructed the jury to be careful when considering the various witness testimonies.
sentences.zh: 鉴于自德尔德丽遇害以来已经过去了很长时间，法官指示陪审团在权衡各方证人证词时要谨慎。

sentences.en: It was possible that individuals were misremembering things or had been influenced by media coverage or hearsay.
sentences.zh: 个人有可能记错了事情，或者受到了媒体报道或道听途说的影响。

sentences.en: He also highlighted the difference in expert opinion regarding the teeth marks in both
sentences.zh: 他还强调了在……中，专家对牙印意见的分歧

sentences.en: the murder and perjury trial and urged the jury not to put blind trust in the expert opinions.
sentences.zh: 在谋杀案和伪证案审判中，他敦促陪审团不要盲目信任专家的意见。

sentences.en: In summing up, the judge clarified, quote,
sentences.zh: 法官在总结陈词中澄清道，原话是：

sentences.en: The only real issue is whether Raymond Carroll told a lie when in the murder trial he said he did not kill Deirdre Kennedy.
sentences.zh: “唯一的实质性问题是，雷蒙德·卡罗尔在谋杀案审判中说他没有杀害德尔德丽·肯尼迪时是否说了谎。”

sentences.en: If he did kill Deirdre Kennedy, you may think it plain that that was something well known to him.
sentences.zh: “如果他确实杀害了德尔德丽·肯尼迪，你们可能会认为这对他来说是心知肚明的。”

sentences.en: If you conclude that it is not established beyond reasonable doubt that he did kill Deirdre Kennedy, it follows that it has not been proved beyond reasonable doubt that the
sentences.zh: “如果你们得出结论，认为没有排除合理怀疑地确凿证明他杀害了德尔德丽·肯尼迪，那么由此推断，也没有排除合理怀疑地证明

sentences.en: accused gave false testimony and the verdict must be not guilty.
sentences.zh: 被告作了虚假证词，裁决必须是无罪。”

sentences.en: The next day the jury delivered their verdict.
sentences.zh: 第二天，陪审团作出了裁决。

sentences.en: Guilty.
sentences.zh: 有罪。

sentences.en: Handing down the maximum sentence of 14 years imprisonment, the judge stated,
sentences.zh: 法官在宣判最高14年监禁时表示：

sentences.en: It is necessary to bear in mind that the sentence being imposed is for perjury, not for murder.
sentences.zh: “必须记住，正在实施的判决是针对伪证罪，而不是针对谋杀罪。”

sentences.en: It is important not to let the horrific nature of the crime perpetrated on Deirdre Kennedy and its profound impact on the lives of her family divert attention from that fact.
sentences.zh: “重要的是，不要让对德尔德丽·肯尼迪犯下的滔天罪行及其对其家人生活的深远影响转移对这一事实的注意力。”

sentences.en: The Kennedy family were relieved by the guilty verdict as it signalled an end of the media attention.
sentences.zh: 有罪裁决让肯尼迪一家感到宽慰，因为这意味着媒体关注的结束。

sentences.en: But it wasn't over yet.
sentences.zh: 但事情还没有结束。

sentences.en: Once again, Raymond Carroll appealed his conviction.
sentences.zh: 雷蒙德·卡罗尔再次对他的定罪提起了上诉。

sentences.en: His legal team argued that the perjury charge should never have been allowed.
sentences.zh: 他的法律团队辩称，本不应该允许伪证罪指控。

sentences.en: Given that the perjury trial was essentially a do-over of the murder trial, they said it went against the principles of double jeopardy.
sentences.zh: 鉴于伪证案审判本质上是谋杀案审判的重来，他们表示这违背了双重危险原则。

sentences.en: Furthermore, the amount of time that had passed between the crime and the perjury trial meant there was no way that Raymond Carroll was ever going to get a fair trial.
sentences.zh: 此外，犯罪发生与作伪证审判之间流逝的时间，意味着雷蒙德·卡罗尔绝无可能得到公正的审判。

sentences.en: The court of appeal analysed the witness and expert testimony and discovered some major flaws.
sentences.zh: 上诉法院分析了证人证词和专家证言，并发现了几个重大的漏洞。

sentences.en: Jailhouse informant Trevor Swift had testified that his conversations with Carroll had occurred over a number of days following Carroll's arrest for Deirdre's murder.
sentences.zh: 狱中线人特雷弗·斯威夫特曾作证称，他和卡罗尔的对话发生在卡罗尔因谋杀迪尔德丽被捕后的数天内。

sentences.en: Carroll was only held in
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔被关押在

sentences.en: Boggo Road jail for less than 24 hours before being granted bail.
sentences.zh: 博戈罗德监狱的时间不到24小时就获得了保释。

sentences.en: Three appellate judges therefore determined it was unlikely the conversations relayed by Swift ever happened and that he should have never been allowed to testify.
sentences.zh: 因此，三位上诉法官认定，斯威夫特转述的对话不大可能发生过，而且本来就绝不应该允许他作证。

sentences.en: They also thought little weight should have been placed on Desley Hill's testimony.
sentences.zh: 他们还认为，不应对德斯莉·希尔的证词给予太多分量。

sentences.en: Even if Desley's timing was correct and Carroll was in Queensland at the time, it still didn't prove that he'd committed the crime.
sentences.zh: 即使德斯莉的时间点是对的，卡罗尔当时也在昆士兰州，这仍然无法证明他犯下了罪行。

sentences.en: Combined with the differing opinions when it came to the forensic dental evidence, the Court of Appeal concluded that the jury's decision was unsafe and unsatisfactory.
sentences.zh: 结合法医牙科证据方面的不同意见，上诉法院得出结论，陪审团的裁决是不稳妥且令人不满意的。

sentences.en: They agreed that the entire trial had been an abusive process and should never have been allowed.
sentences.zh: 他们一致认为，整个审判是一个滥用程序的过失，本就不该被允许。

sentences.en: For the second time, Raymond Carroll's conviction was overturned and he was allowed to walk free.
sentences.zh: 雷蒙德·卡罗尔的定罪第二次被推翻，他得以重获自由。

sentences.en: Community outrage ensued.
sentences.zh: 随之而来的是社区的愤怒。

sentences.en: Faye Kennedy was so shattered by the news that she collapsed when she heard it.
sentences.zh: 费伊·肯尼迪听到这个消息后悲痛欲绝，当场瘫倒在地。

sentences.en: How could a person be found guilty by two separate juries and continue to walk free?
sentences.zh: 一个人怎么会被两个不同的陪审团判定有罪，却还能继续逍遥法外？

sentences.en: She questioned what the point was of having a jury trial if a judge could overrule their decision.
sentences.zh: 她质疑，如果法官可以推翻陪审团的决定，那么进行陪审团审判还有什么意义。

sentences.en: To Faye, the justice system had failed in every aspect.
sentences.zh: 对费伊而言，司法系统在各个方面都失败了。

sentences.en: She pleaded that the case be sent to the High Court and her request was granted.
sentences.zh: 她恳求将此案提交至高等法院，她的请求得到了批准。

sentences.en: But the High Court not only concluded that none of the evidence presented at the perjury trial was new and compelling, they also agreed the entire trial was
sentences.zh: 但高等法院不仅断定伪证审判中出示的任何证据都不是新的且具有说服力的，还一致认为整个审判

sentences.en: inconsistent with the principles of double jeopardy.
sentences.zh: 不符合一事不再理的原则。

sentences.en: Even if the evidence had been compelling, the High Court determined it didn't matter because Raymond Carroll should still be protected by double jeopardy laws.
sentences.zh: 即使证据具有说服力，高等法院也认定这无关紧要，因为雷蒙德·卡罗尔仍应受到一事不再理法律的保护。

sentences.en: Justice Angelo Vasta, who had served as the judge in Raymond Carroll's murder trial, later told Australian story,
sentences.zh: 曾担任雷蒙德·卡罗尔谋杀案审判法官的安杰洛·瓦斯塔法官后来告诉澳大利亚故事栏目称：

sentences.en: This is one of the rare cases where I think the law has been over-technical, and in those circumstances I think that justice has not been done.
sentences.zh: 这是罕见的几个案件之一，我认为法律过于拘泥于技术细节，在那种情况下，我认为正义并未得到伸张。

sentences.en: People know that Carroll is responsible for this death when 24 people have said, in a properly constituted court, that he is guilty.
sentences.zh: 人们知道卡罗尔要为这条生命负责，因为有24人在一个合法组成的法庭上说过他有罪。

sentences.en: The tentacles of justice just can't reach him.
sentences.zh: 正义的触角就是够不到他。

sentences.en: Throughout all the years of legal action, Raymond Carroll never once spoke to the media.
sentences.zh: 在多年的法律诉讼中，雷蒙德·卡罗尔从未对媒体说过一句话。

sentences.en: In 2006, he broke his silence after 33 years by appearing on current affairs program
sentences.zh: 2006年，在沉默33年后，他出现在时事节目中，打破了沉默

sentences.en: 60 minutes.
Carroll wasn't paid for the interview, but he agreed to go through with it on one condition,
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔没有收取采访费用，但他同意接受采访只有一个条件：

sentences.en: that the producers organised for him to undergo a lie detector teSt. The polygraph expert hooked
sentences.zh: 让制作人为他安排接受测谎仪测试。测谎专家将

sentences.en: Carroll up to the machine and asked him a series of questions.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔连接到机器上，并向他提出了系列问题。

sentences.en: Among them was,
sentences.zh: 其中包括：

sentences.en: Did you kill Deirdre Kennedy?
sentences.zh: 你杀了迪尔德丽·肯尼迪吗？

sentences.en: Carroll's response was firm,
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔的回答很坚定：

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: According to the lie detector, he was telling the truth.
sentences.zh: 根据测谎仪显示，他说的是实话。

sentences.en: The interviewing journalist Richard Carlton put it to Carroll that he was actually guilty of Deirdre's murder, but had spent all these years
sentences.zh: 采访记者理查德·卡尔顿向卡罗尔指出，他其实犯下了谋杀迪尔德丽的罪行，但这些年来

sentences.en: successfully convincing himself of the opposite.
sentences.zh: 成功说服自己相信并非如此。

sentences.en: Carroll bluntly denied this allegation.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔直截了当地否认了这一指控。

sentences.en: He stated,
sentences.zh: 他表示：

sentences.en: I feel extremely sorry for Mrs. Kennedy, for her loss.
sentences.zh: 我为肯尼迪夫人感到非常遗憾，为她的失去感到难过。

sentences.en: I honestly hope she does get closure for this crime.
sentences.zh: 我真心希望她能为这起犯罪得到一个了结。

sentences.en: But I'm sorry, she is not going to get it at my expense, because I did not do it.
sentences.zh: 但很抱歉，她不会以牺牲我为代价得到这个，因为我没有做过。

sentences.en: Faye and Barry's marriage didn't survive the trauma of their ordeal.
sentences.zh: 费伊和巴里的婚姻没能挺过这场劫难带来的创伤。

sentences.en: They divorced in the early 90s after
sentences.zh: 他们在90年代初离婚了，结束了

sentences.en: 25 years of marriage.
sentences.zh: 25年的婚姻。

sentences.en: Speaking of Raymond Carroll, Faye told Australian Story,
sentences.zh: 在谈到雷蒙德·卡罗尔时，费伊告诉澳大利亚故事栏目：

sentences.en: I believe a good marriage was destroyed by this person.
sentences.zh: 我相信一段美好的婚姻被这个人毁了。

sentences.en: Faye resettled in Ipswich, where she got a job at the local supermarket.
sentences.zh: 费伊重新在伊普斯维奇安顿下来，并在当地一家超市找到了一份工作。

sentences.en: One day, she was working behind the checkout counter when Raymond Carroll walked in.
sentences.zh: 有一天，她正在收银台后面工作，雷蒙德·卡罗尔走了进来。

sentences.en: He too had relocated to Ipswich, and the very sight of him gave Faye a terrible shock.
sentences.zh: 他也搬到了伊普斯维奇，他的出现让费伊大受震撼。

sentences.en: She refused to serve him, and one of her co-workers had to step in.
sentences.zh: 她拒绝接待他，其中一位同事不得不介入。,

sentences.en: According to Faye, Carroll seemed unperturbed by the encounter.
sentences.zh: 据费伊称，卡罗尔对这次相遇似乎无动于衷。

sentences.en: Faye Kennedy began working with politicians to petition for changes to be made to Queensland's double jeopardy laws, which they hoped to be dubbed Deirdre's law.
sentences.zh: 费伊·肯尼迪开始与政治人物合作，请愿修改昆士兰州的一事不再理法律，他们希望将其命名为迪尔德丽法。

sentences.en: They argued that the 800-year-old law was outdated and hadn't kept in line with technological advancements or investigative techniques.
sentences.zh: 他们辩称，这项已有800年历史的法律已经过时，没有跟上技术进步或调查技术的步伐。

sentences.en: Unless the laws were updated, a suspect could walk free even if evidence had since become available that unequivocally proved their guilt.
sentences.zh: 除非修改法律，否则即使后来出现了能够明确证明嫌疑人有罪的证据，嫌疑人也可能逍遥法外。

sentences.en: Faye hoped to have 10,000 people sign her petition.
sentences.zh: 费伊希望有1万人签署她的请愿书。

sentences.en: Within 12 weeks, she'd tripled that, with over 33,000 members of the community showing their support.
sentences.zh: 在12周内，这一数字翻了三番，有超过33000名社区成员表达了他们的支持。

sentences.en: Speaking in Parliament House, former police officer turned Member of Parliament Peter Dutton stated,
sentences.zh: 前警官出身的国会议员彼得·达顿在议会大厦发言时表示：

sentences.en: The heartbreak felt by Mrs Kennedy and other brave members of the Kennedy family is absolutely unimaginable.
sentences.zh: 肯尼迪夫人和肯尼迪家族其他勇敢的成员所感受到的心碎是绝对无法想象的。

sentences.en: I can tell you that there is no doubt in the mind of Mrs Kennedy, or anybody with knowledge of this case, that the evidence proves the suspect's guilt.
sentences.zh: 我可以告诉你们，肯尼迪夫人或任何了解此案的人都毫不怀疑，证据证明了嫌疑人有罪。

sentences.en: No doubt at all.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问。

sentences.en: Yet, thirty years after the crime, this killer is allowed to walk free and taunt Mrs Kennedy by living in her local area and shopping at her workplace.
sentences.zh: 然而，在犯罪发生三十年后，这个杀人犯却可以逍遥法外，通过住在她的当地社区并在她工作的地方购物来嘲弄肯尼迪夫人。

sentences.en: In my view, it is a travesty that advances in forensic technology mean nothing in this case, because double jeopardy prevents a retrial to prove the suspect's guilt.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，法医技术的进步在这个案件中毫无意义，这是一场悲剧，因为一事不再理阻止了重新审判以证明嫌疑人的有罪。

sentences.en: And what is worse is that, as the technology improves, more acquittals in the future could be called into question and create the same heartbreaking situation for other families,
sentences.zh: 更糟糕的是，随着技术的改进，未来更多的无罪释放可能会受到质疑，并为其他家庭造成同样令人心碎的情况，

sentences.en: states not just in Queensland, but around the nation.
sentences.zh: 不仅在昆士兰州，而且在全国各地都是如此。

sentences.en: I share a view with Mrs Kennedy that there is something basically and fundamentally wrong with a legal system that allows a child killer and rapist to walk free.
sentences.zh: 我与肯尼迪夫人有同感，一个允许儿童杀手和强奸犯逍遥法外的法律系统存在着根本性且彻底的错误。

sentences.en: Faye told Sixty Minutes,
sentences.zh: 费伊告诉《60分钟》节目：

sentences.en: If I could change this law for one other family, I've done some good.
sentences.zh: 如果我能为另一个家庭改变这条法律，我就做了一件好事。

sentences.en: It just seems so wrong that this can go on.
sentences.zh: 这种情况居然能持续下去，实在是太离谱了。

sentences.en: Who else has suffered like I have because of a law?
sentences.zh: 还有谁像我一样因为一条法律而遭受痛苦？

sentences.en: I just feel driven to do this, and I believe I will get this result that I'm looking for.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得自己受到驱使去做这件事，我相信我会得到我想要的结果。

sentences.en: I believe that with all my heart that the people of Queensland will support me.
sentences.zh: 我坚信昆士兰人民会支持我。

sentences.en: I need them to, and I have faith that they will.
sentences.zh: 我需要他们的支持，我相信他们会做到的。

sentences.en: And they did.
sentences.zh: 他们确实做到了。

sentences.en: In 2007, Queensland's law was amended so that a person previously acquitted of murder could be
sentences.zh: 2007年，昆士兰州的法律进行了修改，以便先前被判谋杀罪名不成立的人可以

sentences.en: retried if there was fresh and compelling evidence against them, and it was in the interest of justice to do so.
sentences.zh: 在有针对他们的新且具有说服力的证据，且这样做符合司法利益的情况下被重新审判。

sentences.en: The laws also allowed for a retrial in the case of a tainted acquittal, for example, if a juror had been bribed.
sentences.zh: 这些法律还允许在无罪释放受污染的情况下进行重新审判，例如，如果陪审员被贿赂。

sentences.en: Faye told the Courier-Mail she was elated that the changes had been named Deirdre's law, commenting,
sentences.zh: 费伊告诉《信使邮报》，她对这些修改被命名为迪尔德丽法感到欢欣鼓舞，并评论道：

sentences.en: We said from the start this would be her law.
sentences.zh: 我们从一开始就说过这将是她的法律。

sentences.en: Faye eventually moved to the rural town of Laidli,
sentences.zh: 费伊最终搬到了乡村小镇莱德利，

sentences.en: 46 kilometres west of Ipswich.
sentences.zh: 位于伊普斯维奇以西46公里处。

sentences.en: In her bedroom, she safely stored items belonging to her beloved baby Deirdre in a pink memory chest adorned with flowers.
sentences.zh: 在她的卧室里，她安全地将她心爱的宝贝迪尔德丽的物品存放在一个饰有鲜花的粉红色记忆箱中。

sentences.en: Inside was Deirdre's baby bracelet, a brooch, an Easter egg, a memorial plaque, and an urn containing Deirdre's ashes.
sentences.zh: 里面有迪尔德丽的婴儿手链、一枚胸针、一个复活节彩蛋、一块纪念牌和一个装有迪尔德丽骨灰的骨灰瓮。

sentences.en: Faye kept the chest locked at all times, protective of the only physical possessions that kept her connected to her daughter.
sentences.zh: 费伊时刻将箱子锁好，以此保护那些唯一能让她与女儿保持联系的实体物品。

sentences.en: On the afternoon of Sunday October 3, 2010, the now 61-year-old Faye visited her son's home in a nearby town to watch the National Rugby League Grand Final.
sentences.zh: 2010年10月3日星期日下午，时年61岁的费伊前往附近小镇她儿子的家观看国家英式橄榄球联赛总决赛。

sentences.en: When she returned home that evening, she discovered that her house had been broken into.
sentences.zh: 当她当晚回家时，她发现她的房子被盗了。

sentences.en: Thieves had gained access via a sliding door before stealing several items, including a laptop and
sentences.zh: 小偷通过一扇滑动门潜入，然后偷走了几件物品，包括一台笔记本电脑和

sentences.en: DVDs.
sentences.zh: DVD。

sentences.en: In Faye's bedroom, the thieves had broken the lock to Deirdre's memory chest and took the contents from within, including Deirdre's ashes.
sentences.zh: 在费伊的卧室里，小偷砸坏了迪尔德丽记忆箱的锁，拿走了里面的东西，包括迪尔德丽的骨灰。

sentences.en: Faye was utterly heartbroken.
sentences.zh: 费伊心碎欲绝。

sentences.en: Of all the untouched belongings in her home, she couldn't believe that the thieves had taken her most prized possessions.
sentences.zh: 在她家中所有未被触碰的物品中，她简直不敢相信小偷拿走了她最珍贵的财产。

sentences.en: Though priceless to her, they held no monetary value to anyone else.
sentences.zh: 虽然对她而言无价，但对其他人来说它们没有任何金钱价值。

sentences.en: Faye appeared on ABC News to make an emotional plea for the safe return of her daughter's ashes, saying through tears,
sentences.zh: 费伊出现在美国广播公司新闻上，含泪发出情感恳求，希望安全归还她女儿的骨灰，她含泪说道：

sentences.en: I feel like I've lost her twice, and I need to have her back.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我失去了她两次，我需要把她找回来。

sentences.en: I just need her home.
sentences.zh: 我只是需要她回家。

sentences.en: Police didn't believe it was a targeted attack and deemed it unlikely that the thieves understood the significance of what they'd taken.
sentences.zh: 警方不认为这是一起有针对性的袭击，并认为小偷不太可能理解他们所拿走东西的重要意义。

sentences.en: All too aware of the ongoing pain endured by the Kennedy family, police appealed for the thieves to return Deirdre's belongings and wasted no time investigating the matter.
sentences.zh: 警方非常清楚肯尼迪家族所承受的持续痛苦，呼吁小偷归还迪尔德丽的物品，并毫不迟疑地对此事展开调查。

sentences.en: They interviewed over 40 persons of interest and searched several homes, while members of the
sentences.zh: 他们讯问了40多名相关人员并搜查了几个房屋，同时

sentences.en: community rallied together to raise a $3,000 reward for anyone who had information about the crime.
sentences.zh: 社区成员团结起来为任何掌握该犯罪信息的人筹集3000美元的悬赏金。

sentences.en: But, eight months later, the crime remained unsolved.
sentences.zh: 但是，八个月过去了，这起案件仍然未破。

sentences.en: Faye told the Courier Mail,
sentences.zh: 费伊告诉《信使邮报》：

sentences.en: Some days I'm really low, and other days I think, I'm just not going to give up hope.
sentences.zh: 有时我情绪非常低落，而有时我想，我绝不会放弃希望。

sentences.en: On Saturday April 13, 2013, relatives of the Kennedy family and members of the Ipswich community gathered in Limestone Park to mark the 40-year anniversary of Deirdre's death.
sentences.zh: 2013年4月13日星期六，肯尼迪家族的亲属和伊普斯维奇社区的成员聚集在石灰石公园，纪念迪尔德丽逝世40周年。

sentences.en: Despite the decades that had passed, the crime still served as a constant reminder that dangers lurked in the most unsuspecting of places.
sentences.zh: 尽管几十年过去了，这起犯罪仍然是一个不断的提醒，即危险潜伏在最让人意想不到的地方。

sentences.en: In a rotunda overlooking the Oval, a memorial plaque was unveiled in Deirdre's honour.
sentences.zh: 在俯瞰椭圆形球场的圆形大厅里，为纪念迪尔德丽揭幕了一块纪念牌。

sentences.en: Faye Kennedy told the Courier Mail,
sentences.zh: 费伊·肯尼迪告诉《信使邮报》：

sentences.en: I hope it creates awareness and lets children know there are some nasties out there.
sentences.zh: 我希望这能引起人们的意识，并让孩子们知道外面有一些坏人。

sentences.en: The mayor of Ipswich said the crime changed Ipswich forever, commenting,
sentences.zh: 伊普斯维奇市长表示，这起犯罪永远改变了伊普斯维奇，并评论道：

sentences.en: As a city, we want Faye and her family to know we share her grief and pain.
sentences.zh: 作为一座城市，我们希望费伊和她的家人知道，我们分担她的悲伤和痛苦。

sentences.en: It's a strong reminder to look after our kids.
sentences.zh: 这是一个强有力的提醒，要照顾好我们的孩子。

sentences.en: The plaque reads,
sentences.zh: 牌匾上写着：

sentences.en: Dedicated in loving memory of Deirdre Marie Kennedy,
sentences.zh: 谨此深情纪念迪尔德丽·玛丽·肯尼迪，
zh_words: 纪念迪尔德丽·玛丽·肯尼迪

sentences.en: We cannot stop the hands of time, nor live again the past, but we shall love and think of you as long as time shall laSt.
sentences.zh: 我们无法阻止时间的双手，也无法重活过去，但只要时间长存，我们就会一直爱着你、思念你。

sentences.en: A life that touches others goes on forever.
sentences.zh: 触动他人生命的生命将永远延续。
